collocations: show the vectors are linearly dependent

words.enDefinition: Allowing only zero coefficients in any linear combination that equals zero.

examples.en: The first two columns were linearly independent because neither was a multiple of the other.
examples.zh: 前两个列向量「线性无关」，因为它们互不为倍数。

examples.en: We showed the polynomials were linearly independent by comparing coefficients after setting their linear combination to zero.
examples.zh: 我们令这些多项式的线性组合等于零，再比较各次幂的系数，证明它们「线性无关」。

collocations: prove the vectors are linearly independent

words.enDefinition: Maximum or minimum value compared with nearby values within the domain

examples.en: The function has a local extremum even though greater values occur farther away.
examples.zh: 尽管更远处还有更大的函数值，该函数仍有一个「局部极值」。

examples.en: We checked points on both sides before declaring a local extremum in the example.
examples.zh: 在例子中，我们检查了两侧的点后，才确定这里取得「局部极值」。

collocations: necessary condition for a local extremum

words.enDefinition: Function value at least as large as all sufficiently nearby values

examples.en: The smaller peak's height is a local maximum even though the next peak is taller.
examples.zh: 虽然下一个峰更高，较小峰的高度仍是一个「局部最大值」。

examples.en: We found a local maximum where the derivative changed from positive to negative.
examples.zh: 我们在导数由正变负的位置找到了「局部最大值」。

words.enDefinition: Function value at most as large as all sufficiently nearby values

examples.en: The graph has a local minimum at the bottom of the small valley.
examples.zh: 图像在较小凹谷的底部有一个「局部最小值」。

examples.en: The nearby values on both sides were higher than the local minimum at the turning point.
examples.zh: 转折处两侧附近的函数值都高于这个「局部最小值」。

words.enDefinition: Parameter shifting a distribution along its scale without changing its shape

examples.en: We changed the location parameter and watched the whole curve slide to the right.
examples.zh: 我们改变「位置参数」，观察整条曲线向右移动。

examples.en: The location parameter is the mean for the normal family used in our model.
examples.zh: 在我们模型所用的正态分布族中，「位置参数」就是均值。

words.enDefinition: The natural logarithm of the likelihood, with the same maximizers where the likelihood is positive.

examples.en: The log-likelihood turns the product of positive contributions into a sum in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂示例中的「对数似然」将各正贡献项的乘积化成和。

examples.en: We calculated the log-likelihood for several candidate values before finding its maximum on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们先算出几个候选值对应的「对数似然」，再在练习上找它的最大值。

words.enDefinition: Derivative of a positive function's logarithm, equal to its derivative divided by itself

examples.en: We found the logarithmic derivative before multiplying back by the positive function in the exercise.
examples.zh: 习题中，我们先求出「对数导数」，再乘回原来的正函数。

examples.en: The logarithmic derivative of a product equals the sum for its positive factors.
examples.zh: 正因子的乘积的「对数导数」等于各因子的对数导数之和。

collocations: compute the logarithmic derivative of a product

words.enDefinition: Technique taking logarithms before differentiating, often to simplify products or variable powers

examples.en: We chose logarithmic differentiation because both the base and the exponent involved the variable.
examples.zh: 由于底数和指数里都有变量，我们选择了「对数求导法」。

examples.en: The tutor used logarithmic differentiation to turn several multiplied factors into a sum.
examples.zh: 老师用「对数求导法」把几个相乘的因子变成了求和。

collocations: solve a derivative by logarithmic differentiation

words.enDefinition: Positive distribution obtained by exponentiating a normally distributed random variable

examples.en: We modeled positive durations with a lognormal distribution to allow an extended right tail.
examples.zh: 我们用「对数正态分布」对正的持续时间建模，使分布可以有较长的右尾。

examples.en: Taking logarithms of values from a lognormal distribution gives a normal distribution in theory.
examples.zh: 在理论上，对服从「对数正态分布」的变量取对数会得到正态分布。

words.enDefinition: a replacement of a matrix by a lower-rank matrix chosen to preserve important structure and limit a stated error

examples.en: The example used a low-rank approximation so the chart could be reconstructed from fewer stored values.
examples.zh: 示例用「低秩近似」，让图表可由较少存储值重建。

examples.en: We compared two versions of a low-rank approximation after measuring errors in their reconstructed matrices.
examples.zh: 我们衡量重建矩阵的误差后，比较了两个版本的「低秩近似」。

collocations: measure error in a low-rank approximation
choose the rank of a low-rank approximation

words.enDefinition: a sum using the infimum of a bounded function on each subinterval times that subinterval's width

examples.en: The lower Darboux sum used the greatest lower bound of the function values on each subinterval.
examples.zh: 加总各加权项时，「达布下和」使用各子区间上函数值的最大下界。

examples.en: We improved the lower Darboux sum by splitting the subinterval that contributed most of the remaining gap.
examples.zh: 我们细分了对剩余差距贡献最大的子区间，从而提高「达布下和」。

collocations: compare upper and lower Darboux sums

words.enDefinition: the starting bound written below an integral sign in a definite integral

examples.en: The lower limit of integration was the time when observations first began in the classroom experiment.
examples.zh: 「积分下限」是课堂实验中开始观测的时刻。

examples.en: We changed the lower limit of integration after deciding to measure the change from an earlier date.
examples.zh: 决定从更早的日期量起后，我们改了「积分下限」。

collocations: set the lower limit of integration
read the lower limit of integration
change the lower limit of integration

words.enDefinition: A square matrix with every entry above its main diagonal equal to zero.

examples.en: We identified a lower triangular matrix by checking that all entries above the diagonal were zero.
examples.zh: 我们检查了对角线上方的元素都为零，认出这是一个「下三角矩阵」。

examples.en: Our tutor transposed a lower triangular matrix to show where the zeros moved in the example.
examples.zh: 老师将一个「下三角矩阵」转置，展示例题中零元素移到了哪些位置。

words.enDefinition: a Taylor polynomial centred at zero

examples.en: The Maclaurin polynomial matched the function's value and its first three derivatives at zero in our example.
examples.zh: 示例里，「麦克劳林多项式」与函数及其前三阶导数在零处的值一致。

examples.en: We used a Maclaurin polynomial to estimate the value at a point close to zero in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上用「麦克劳林多项式」估计靠近零处的函数值。

collocations: compute a Maclaurin polynomial near zero

words.enDefinition: a Taylor series whose centre is zero

examples.en: We wrote the Maclaurin series using derivatives evaluated at zero before checking its interval of convergence.
examples.zh: 我们用在零处计算的导数写出「麦克劳林级数」，再检查它的收敛区间。

examples.en: The worksheet obtained a new Maclaurin series by substituting a squared variable into a known expansion.
examples.zh: 练习表把自变量的平方代入一个已知展开式，得到新的「麦克劳林级数」。

collocations: derive a Maclaurin series by substitution
test convergence of a Maclaurin series

words.enDefinition: The sequence of entries whose row and column numbers are equal.

examples.en: We marked the main diagonal before checking which entries remained in the same positions after transposing.
examples.zh: 我们先标出「主对角线」，再核对哪些元素转置后仍留在原处。

examples.en: The main diagonal of the example contained three numbers, with a zero in the middle.
examples.zh: 例题的「主对角线」有三个数，中间是零。

words.zhGloss: 曼—惠特尼 U 检验
words.enDefinition: A rank-based test comparing two independent groups, with a location interpretation under additional distributional assumptions.
acceptedZhAnswers: 曼—惠特尼 U 检验

examples.en: The Mann-Whitney U test ranks both groups together before assessing whether one tends to yield higher readings.
examples.zh: 「曼—惠特尼 U 检验」先将两组一起排序，再评估其中一组的读数是否往往较高。

examples.en: We discussed when a Mann-Whitney U test could be interpreted as a comparison of locations.
examples.zh: 我们讨论在什么条件下「曼—惠特尼 U 检验」可以解释为位置比较。

collocations: assumptions of a Mann-Whitney U test

words.enDefinition: The distance from an estimate to either endpoint of a symmetric confidence interval.

examples.en: The margin of error is the amount added to and subtracted from the estimate in this interval.
examples.zh: 在这个区间里，「误差限」就是估计值上下各加减的数值。

examples.en: We recalculated the margin of error after increasing the sample size in the classroom survey.
examples.zh: 我们增大课堂调查的样本量后，重新计算了「误差限」。

collocations: margin of error for an estimate

words.enDefinition: Distribution of selected variables obtained by summing or integrating over the others

examples.en: We summed across colors to get the marginal distribution of tile size.
examples.zh: 我们对各种颜色求和，得到了牌大小的「边缘分布」。

examples.en: The worksheet asks for the marginal distribution of one variable from the joint density.
examples.zh: 习题要求根据联合密度求出一个变量的「边缘分布」。

collocations: calculate a marginal distribution from a joint table

words.enDefinition: Probability of one event obtained without restricting the other outcomes or variables

examples.en: We found the marginal probability of blue by including all shapes in that color.
examples.zh: 我们把这种颜色的所有形状都算上，求出了蓝色的「边缘概率」。

examples.en: The marginal probability in the table can be read by summing across one row.
examples.zh: 把表中一行的各项相加，就能得到对应的「边缘概率」。

collocations: find a marginal probability by summing

words.enDefinition: Sum or integrate out uncertain values to obtain a distribution of remaining variables

examples.en: To find the distribution of tile size, we marginalize over the observed colors.
examples.zh: 为求出牌大小的分布，我们「对所观测的颜色变量边缘化」。

examples.en: The worksheet asks us to marginalize over one variable using an integral.
examples.zh: 习题要求我们用积分「对一个变量进行边缘化」。

words.enDefinition: Bound on a nonnegative variable's upper tail using its mean and threshold

examples.en: We used Markov's inequality to bound the chance of exceeding a positive threshold.
examples.zh: 我们用「马尔可夫不等式」给超过一个正阈值的概率定出上界。

examples.en: The theorem sheet requires a nonnegative variable before we apply Markov's inequality.
examples.zh: 定理讲义要求变量非负，才能应用「马尔可夫不等式」。

collocations: bound a probability using Markov's inequality

words.enDefinition: Adding corresponding entries of two matrices with the same dimensions.

examples.en: We used matrix addition to combine the quantities recorded by two groups in the same layout.
examples.zh: 我们用「矩阵加法」合并两组按同样版式记录的数量。

examples.en: The tutor ruled out matrix addition because one table had an extra column.
examples.zh: 其中一张表多出一列，因此老师排除了使用「矩阵加法」。

collocations: use matrix addition to combine two tables

words.enDefinition: A rectangular arrangement of entries in rows and columns.

examples.en: We wrote a matrix showing how many parts each group needed for its two models.
examples.zh: 我们写了一个「矩阵」，表示各组制作两个模型分别需要多少零件。

examples.en: The tutor drew a matrix on the board before explaining how its entries were indexed.
examples.zh: 老师先在黑板上画了一个「矩阵」，再解释怎样用索引表示其中的元素。

words.enDefinition: a relation obtained by transforming a bilinear form's matrix with an invertible matrix on one side and its transpose on the other

examples.en: We used matrix congruence to express the same real quadratic form in a different set of coordinates.
examples.zh: 我们用「矩阵合同」在另一组坐标下表示同一个实二次型。

examples.en: The tutor distinguished matrix congruence from similarity before comparing what changed in the two resulting matrices.
examples.zh: 导师在比较两个所得矩阵的变化之前，先区分了「矩阵合同」和相似。

collocations: diagonalize a form by matrix congruence

words.enDefinition: rewriting a square matrix in a basis of eigenvectors so its representation is diagonal

examples.en: We used matrix diagonalization to replace the original calculation with one involving independent powers of eigenvalues.
examples.zh: 我们用「矩阵对角化」将原计算改为分别求各特征值的幂。

examples.en: The tutor checked the order of the eigenvectors and eigenvalues after completing matrix diagonalization in the exercise.
examples.zh: 在练习里完成「矩阵对角化」后，导师核对了特征向量与特征值的顺序。

collocations: apply matrix diagonalization to a recurrence

words.enDefinition: The numbers of rows and columns in a matrix, stated in that order.

examples.en: We stated the matrix dimensions as three by four before looking for possible products.
examples.zh: 在寻找哪些乘积可以计算之前，我们注明「矩阵的行列数」为三行四列。

examples.en: The tutor checked the matrix dimensions after we added another column to the example.
examples.zh: 我们给例题增添一列后，老师核对了「矩阵的行列数」。

collocations: compare the matrix dimensions before multiplying

words.enDefinition: The value at a specified row and column of a matrix.

examples.en: We located the matrix entry in the second row and third column of the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们在练习表上找到了第二行第三列的「矩阵元素」。

examples.en: Our tutor changed one matrix entry so we could see which answers were affected.
examples.zh: 老师改动了一个「矩阵元素」，让我们看出哪些结果会受到影响。

words.enDefinition: An equation in which a matrix or matrix operation appears.

examples.en: We wrote a matrix equation with the coefficient matrix multiplying the vector of unknowns.
examples.zh: 我们写出一个「矩阵方程」，左端是系数矩阵乘以未知量向量。

examples.en: The tutor checked the matrix equation before beginning the elimination steps on the board.
examples.zh: 老师核查了「矩阵方程」，才开始在黑板上做消元。

collocations: translate a system into a matrix equation

words.enDefinition: the matrix function defined by the exponential power series with a square matrix as its argument

examples.en: The matrix exponential solved the example system describing two quantities whose rates of change were linked.
examples.zh: 我们用「矩阵指数」解出示例方程组，其中两个量的变化率相互关联。

examples.en: We computed the matrix exponential using a diagonal representation and then returned to the original basis.
examples.zh: 我们用对角表示计算「矩阵指数」，然后换回原来的基。

collocations: express a solution using a matrix exponential
evaluate the matrix exponential of a diagonal matrix

words.enDefinition: The matrix whose products with the original square matrix in both orders give the identity.

examples.en: We verified the matrix inverse by multiplying it with the original in both orders.
examples.zh: 我们把「逆矩阵」与原矩阵分别按两种顺序相乘，验证了结果。

examples.en: The tutor used the matrix inverse to undo the effect of the first transformation.
examples.zh: 老师用「逆矩阵」消除第一个变换的作用。

words.enDefinition: For an entry of a square matrix, the determinant obtained by deleting its row and column.

examples.en: We found a matrix minor by deleting the row and column containing the selected entry.
examples.zh: 我们删去选中元素所在的行和列，求得相应的「矩阵子式」。

examples.en: The tutor calculated the matrix minor before applying its sign in the determinant expansion.
examples.zh: 老师先计算「矩阵子式」，再在行列式展开中加上它的符号。

collocations: form a matrix minor by deleting a row and column
use a matrix minor in an expansion

words.enDefinition: Multiplying matrices by summing pairwise products of corresponding entries in each selected row and column.

examples.en: The tutor demonstrated matrix multiplication by beginning with the first row and the second column.
examples.zh: 老师从第一行和第二列开始演示「矩阵乘法」。

examples.en: We checked the dimensions before attempting matrix multiplication in the order given on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 按练习表给出的顺序进行「矩阵乘法」之前，我们先核查了行列数。

collocations: check the inner dimensions for matrix multiplication
reverse the order of matrix multiplication

words.enDefinition: a function assigning a nonnegative size to a matrix that satisfies the norm axioms on a matrix space

examples.en: The tutor specified a matrix norm before comparing two approximations of different entries in the same table.
examples.zh: 导师先指定一种「矩阵范数」，再比较对同一表格各元素的两种近似。

examples.en: We changed the matrix norm to emphasise the largest stretching effect instead of accumulated entrywise error.
examples.zh: 我们更换「矩阵范数」，着重考虑最大拉伸作用，而非各元素误差的累积。

collocations: compare bounds in two matrix norms

words.enDefinition: A square matrix multiplied by itself as many times as specified by a positive integer exponent

examples.en: The worksheet rewrote the matrix power with exponent three as a product of three identical factors.
examples.zh: 练习表将指数为三的「矩阵的幂」改写为三个相同因子的乘积。

examples.en: We calculated the matrix power by multiplying the same square matrix several times in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上将同一个方阵连续相乘，算出了「矩阵的幂」。

collocations: find a matrix power by repeated multiplication
write a matrix power in expanded form

words.enDefinition: The resulting matrix obtained when compatible matrices are multiplied in a specified order.

examples.en: The matrix product had three rows from the first matrix and two columns from the second.
examples.zh: 「矩阵乘积」有三行，由第一个矩阵决定，也有两列，由第二个矩阵决定。

examples.en: Our partner found a different matrix product after reversing the order of the same two factors.
examples.zh: 我们同伴交换了相同两个因子的顺序，得到不同的「矩阵乘积」。

collocations: write the dimensions of a matrix product

words.enDefinition: A matrix that expresses a linear map relative to chosen bases of its domain and codomain.

examples.en: We found the matrix representation by placing the output coordinates for each input basis vector in columns.
examples.zh: 我们将每个输入基向量的输出坐标按列排列，得到了「矩阵表示」。

examples.en: The matrix representation looked different when we chose a new basis for the codomain in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们给陪域选了一组新的基，映射的「矩阵表示」随之改变。

collocations: a matrix representation of a linear map

words.enDefinition: Subtracting corresponding entries of two matrices with the same dimensions.

examples.en: The exercise used matrix subtraction to show how the quantities changed from the first week.
examples.zh: 练习用「矩阵减法」展示数量相对于第一周有何变化。

examples.en: We checked the order of the two matrices before doing the matrix subtraction.
examples.zh: 进行「矩阵减法」前，我们先核对了两个矩阵的顺序。

words.enDefinition: The matrix obtained by exchanging the rows and columns of the original matrix.

examples.en: The matrix transpose had four rows because the original arrangement contained four columns.
examples.zh: 「矩阵的转置」有四行，因为原矩阵有四列。

examples.en: We checked the position of the first entry after writing the matrix transpose in our notes.
examples.zh: 我们在笔记里写出「矩阵的转置」后，核对了第一个元素的位置。

collocations: compare a matrix transpose with the original

words.enDefinition: The column vector formed by multiplying a matrix by a compatible column vector.

examples.en: We interpreted the matrix-vector product as a weighted sum of the three columns on the board.
examples.zh: 我们把「矩阵与向量的乘积」解释为黑板上三列的加权和。

examples.en: The worksheet checked whether the matrix-vector product matched the displayed right-hand side of the equation.
examples.zh: 练习表检查了「矩阵与向量的乘积」是否与方程所列右端项一致。

collocations: express a matrix-vector product as a column combination

words.enDefinition: Find the largest attained output over the relevant set of inputs

examples.en: To maximize a function on a closed interval, include the two endpoint values in the comparison.
examples.zh: 在闭区间上「求函数的最大值」时，要把两个端点的值也纳入比较。

examples.en: The exercise shows how to maximize a function when there are two interior critical points.
examples.zh: 习题演示了有两个内部临界点时如何「求函数的最大值」。

collocations: maximize a function on an interval
maximize a function subject to a constraint
use derivatives to maximize a function

words.enDefinition: An estimator obtained by selecting parameter values that maximize the likelihood of the observed data.

examples.en: The maximum likelihood estimator selects the proportion that gives the largest likelihood for the observed outcomes.
examples.zh: 「最大似然估计量」选出使观测结果似然最大的比例。

examples.en: We derived a maximum likelihood estimator for the unknown success probability in our classroom model.
examples.zh: 我们推导出一个「最大似然估计量」，用来估计课堂模型中的未知成功概率。

collocations: consistency of a maximum likelihood estimator

words.enDefinition: A test of whether paired binary responses have the same marginal proportions, based on discordant pairs.

examples.en: McNemar's test counts the pairs that change classification between the first and second readings in class.
examples.zh: 「麦克尼马尔检验」统计课堂里第一次和第二次读数的分类不一致的配对。

examples.en: We used McNemar's test because the two binary classifications came from the same simulated devices.
examples.zh: 由于两次二元分类来自同一批模拟设备，我们使用了「麦克尼马尔检验」。

words.enDefinition: A sum of squares divided by its associated degrees of freedom in an analysis of variance.

examples.en: The mean square is obtained by dividing the worksheet's sum of squares by its degrees of freedom.
examples.zh: 「均方」用练习表中的平方和除以相应自由度得到。

examples.en: We calculated each mean square before forming the ratio used in the classroom comparison.
examples.zh: 我们算出各个「均方」，再构造课堂比较所用的比值。

words.enDefinition: Result matching an interior derivative to the average slope under specified conditions

examples.en: The mean value theorem guarantees a tangent parallel to the secant in our example.
examples.zh: 在我们的例子中，「拉格朗日中值定理」保证存在一条与割线平行的切线。

examples.en: We confirmed continuity and differentiability on the appropriate intervals before applying the mean value theorem.
examples.zh: 应用「拉格朗日中值定理」之前，我们分别在相应的区间上确认了连续性和可导性。

collocations: hypothesis of the mean value theorem
point guaranteed by the mean value theorem

words.enDefinition: the theorem that a continuous function on a closed interval takes a value equal to its integral average there

examples.en: The mean value theorem for integrals guaranteed a point where the function equalled its average over the interval.
examples.zh: 「积分中值定理」保证存在一点，函数在该点的值等于区间平均值。

examples.en: Our tutor checked continuity before invoking the mean value theorem for integrals on the illustrated curve.
examples.zh: 导师先检查连续性，再在图示曲线上应用「积分中值定理」。

collocations: apply the mean value theorem for integrals
state the mean value theorem for integrals
verify the mean value theorem for integrals

words.enDefinition: Property where additional waiting has the original distribution after any elapsed wait

examples.en: Because of the memoryless property, the remaining wait has the same law after two minutes.
examples.zh: 由于具有「无记忆性」，等待两分钟后剩余等待时间的分布仍和原先相同。

examples.en: We checked the memoryless property by comparing a conditional waiting probability with its original counterpart.
examples.zh: 我们比较有条件的等待概率和原来的对应概率，检验「无记忆性」。

words.enDefinition: the largest width among the subintervals in a partition

examples.en: The mesh of a partition shrank after we divided every subinterval that shared the maximum width.
examples.zh: 我们把所有达到最大宽度的子区间细分后，「分割的网格大小」缩小了。

examples.en: The proof made the mesh of a partition approach zero to control the widest possible rectangle.
examples.zh: 证明让「分割的网格大小」趋于零，从而控制最宽矩形的宽度。

collocations: calculate the mesh of a partition
reduce the mesh of a partition
let the mesh of a partition tend to zero

words.enDefinition: A method that estimates parameters by matching sample moments to the corresponding model moments.

examples.en: The method of moments equates the sample mean to its model expectation in this example.
examples.zh: 示例里的「矩估计法」令样本均值等于对应的模型期望。

examples.en: We used the method of moments to estimate two parameters from two sample quantities.
examples.zh: 我们用「矩估计法」，根据两个样本统计量估计两个参数。

collocations: estimate by the method of moments

words.enDefinition: a numerical integration rule estimating each subinterval's contribution from the function at its midpoint

examples.en: The midpoint rule weighted each midpoint value by its subinterval width, which varied across the partition.
examples.zh: 「中点求积公式」用各子区间宽度对对应的中点函数值加权，各区间宽度不同。

examples.en: We compared the midpoint rule with a method using function values at both interval endpoints.
examples.zh: 我们把「中点求积公式」与一种采用各段两个端点函数值的方法作了比较。

collocations: estimate an integral using the midpoint rule
compare the midpoint rule with the trapezoidal rule

words.enDefinition: a Riemann sum using the midpoint of each subinterval to evaluate the function

examples.en: The midpoint sum used heights measured at the centres of the five rectangles shown in the example.
examples.zh: 「中点黎曼和」使用示例中五个矩形底边中心处的函数值作高。

examples.en: We recalculated the midpoint sum with narrower subintervals to check how much the estimate changed.
examples.zh: 我们用较窄子区间重新计算「中点黎曼和」，检查估计值改变了多少。

collocations: use a midpoint sum to approximate an integral

words.enDefinition: the monic polynomial of least positive degree that vanishes when evaluated at a given square matrix

examples.en: The minimal polynomial had lower degree than the characteristic polynomial because the repeated root needed only one factor.
examples.zh: 「最小多项式」的次数低于特征多项式，因为重复根只需要一个因式。

examples.en: We checked that the minimal polynomial divided the characteristic polynomial before verifying the matrix equation.
examples.zh: 我们先核查「最小多项式」能整除特征多项式，再验证矩阵等式。

collocations: evaluate the minimal polynomial at a matrix
compare the minimal and characteristic polynomials

words.enDefinition: Find the smallest attained output over the relevant set of inputs

examples.en: We needed to minimize a function to find the smallest possible surface area for the box.
examples.zh: 我们需要「求函数的最小值」，从而找到盒子可能具有的最小表面积。

examples.en: To minimize a function, compare the outputs at all candidates that satisfy the given restrictions.
examples.zh: 「求函数的最小值」时，要比较所有满足给定约束的候选点对应的函数值。

collocations: minimize a function on an interval
minimize a function subject to a constraint
use derivatives to minimize a function

words.enDefinition: The smallest effect size for which a specified test design is expected to reach a chosen power.

examples.en: The minimum detectable effect depends on sample size and the desired power in our classroom design.
examples.zh: 课堂设计中的「最小可检测效应」取决于样本量和目标功效。

examples.en: We estimated the minimum detectable effect before selecting how many observations to simulate in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先估计「最小可检测效应」，再选定要模拟的观测数。

collocations: minimum detectable effect for a study

words.enDefinition: a solution whose norm is smallest among the vectors satisfying the stated equations or fitting condition

examples.en: The minimum-norm solution removed the part in the null space while leaving the fitted values unchanged.
examples.zh: 「最小范数解」去掉零空间分量，保持拟合值不变。

examples.en: We chose the minimum-norm solution after finding that infinitely many vectors gave the same residual norm.
examples.zh: 发现无穷多个向量给出相同残差范数之后，我们选择了「最小范数解」。

collocations: compute the minimum-norm solution using a pseudoinverse
distinguish a minimum-norm solution from other solutions

words.enDefinition: Distribution having both positive point probabilities and a part described by density

examples.en: Our mixed distribution places some probability at zero and spreads the rest over positive values.
examples.zh: 我们的「混合型分布」将部分概率集中在零，将其余概率分布在正值上。

examples.en: We used a mixed distribution because some people started waiting while others entered immediately.
examples.zh: 有些人开始等待，其他人立即进入，所以我们采用「混合型分布」。

collocations: continuous component of a mixed distribution

words.enDefinition: A higher-order derivative taken with respect to two or more different variables.

examples.en: The mixed partial derivative here differentiates first with respect to position and then with respect to time.
examples.zh: 这里的「混合偏导数」先对位置求导，再对时间求导。

examples.en: We checked whether reversing the order changed the mixed partial derivative for the example function.
examples.zh: 我们检查了示例函数中对调求导顺序是否会改变「混合偏导数」。

words.enDefinition: a Gram-Schmidt variant updating each remaining vector with the current orthonormal direction before continuing, improving numerical behaviour in typical computations

examples.en: The tutor used the modified Gram-Schmidt process after the original method lost accuracy in the example's inner products.
examples.zh: 原方法在示例的内积计算中出现精度损失后，导师采用「修正格拉姆施密特法」。

examples.en: We compared the modified Gram-Schmidt process with the original method using a basis of nearly dependent vectors.
examples.zh: 我们用一组近乎线性相关的向量，比较「修正格拉姆施密特法」与原方法。

collocations: compare the modified Gram-Schmidt process with classical Gram-Schmidt
compute a factor using the modified Gram-Schmidt process

words.enDefinition: Expectation of an exponential of a variable times an argument, where finite

examples.en: We differentiated the moment-generating function at zero to recover the first moment.
examples.zh: 我们在零处对「矩生成函数」求导，得到一阶原点矩。

examples.en: The tutor multiplied two functions to obtain the moment-generating function of their independent sum.
examples.zh: 老师把两个函数相乘，求得两个独立变量之和的「矩生成函数」。

words.enDefinition: the theorem that a nondecreasing sequence bounded above, or a nonincreasing sequence bounded below, converges

examples.en: We applied the monotone convergence theorem after finding an upper bound for the increasing sequence in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们找出递增数列的上界后，应用了「单调收敛定理」。

examples.en: The tutor used the monotone convergence theorem to establish convergence without first finding the limit's value.
examples.zh: 导师用「单调收敛定理」先证明收敛，无须先求出极限值。

collocations: verify conditions of the monotone convergence theorem
use the monotone convergence theorem to prove convergence

words.enDefinition: a sequence whose successive terms are always nondecreasing or always nonincreasing

examples.en: We identified a monotone sequence after showing each term was at least as large as the previous term.
examples.zh: 证明各项都不小于前一项后，我们认定它是「单调数列」。

examples.en: The tutor compared a monotone sequence with one whose terms repeatedly moved above and below zero.
examples.zh: 导师把「单调数列」和各项反复在零的上、下方变动的数列作了比较。

collocations: show that a sequence is monotone

words.enDefinition: the unique generalized inverse satisfying the four Penrose identities, computed from a singular value decomposition by reciprocating nonzero singular values

examples.en: The Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse supplied a coefficient vector for a rectangular matrix with no ordinary inverse.
examples.zh: 尽管课堂矩阵为矩形、没有普通逆矩阵，「摩尔彭若斯伪逆」仍给出了一个系数向量。

examples.en: We used the Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse to find the solution of smallest norm among all least-squares solutions.
examples.zh: 我们用「摩尔彭若斯伪逆」求所有最小二乘解中范数最小的一个。

collocations: check identities for the Moore-Penrose pseudoinverse

words.enDefinition: Number of assignments of distinct objects to labeled groups of specified sizes

examples.en: The multinomial coefficient counts ways to assign six students to three labeled teams of two.
examples.zh: 「多项式系数」计算了把六名学生分到三个有标记、每组两人的小队的分法。

examples.en: We used a multinomial coefficient with the three group size factorials in the denominator.
examples.zh: 我们采用「多项式系数」，在分母写出三个组各自人数的阶乘。

collocations: count arrangements using a multinomial coefficient

words.enDefinition: Joint distribution of category counts across independent trials with fixed category probabilities

examples.en: We used a multinomial distribution to count each face across repeated independent rolls.
examples.zh: 我们用「多项分布」表示多次独立掷骰中各点数出现的次数。

examples.en: The counts under the multinomial distribution must sum to the total number of trials.
examples.zh: 「多项分布」中，各类计数之和必须等于试验总次数。

collocations: category probabilities in a multinomial distribution

words.enDefinition: A set of statistical comparisons considered together because their combined error properties matter.

examples.en: The exercise treats the mean differences as multiple comparisons because all pairwise results will be reported together.
examples.zh: 练习把这些均值差异视为「多重比较」，因为所有两两比较结果都会一起报告。

examples.en: We planned how to handle multiple comparisons before looking at the results for each device.
examples.zh: 我们在查看各设备结果前，就计划好如何处理「多重比较」。

words.enDefinition: Rule multiplying one event's probability by the other's probability conditional on it

examples.en: We used the multiplication rule of probability after finding the probability of blue given an initial red draw.
examples.zh: 求出在第一次抽到红牌的条件下接着抽到蓝牌的概率后，我们使用了「概率乘法法则」。

examples.en: The multiplication rule of probability works here even though the two draws are dependent.
examples.zh: 尽管两次抽取并不独立，「概率乘法法则」在这里仍然适用。

collocations: apply the multiplication rule of probability
use the multiplication rule of probability
derive the multiplication rule of probability

words.enDefinition: The rule that the determinant of a product of same-size square matrices equals the product of their determinants.

examples.en: We applied the multiplicative property of determinants instead of forming the full matrix product first.
examples.zh: 我们应用「行列式的乘法性质」，省去了先算整个矩阵乘积的步骤。

examples.en: The tutor used the multiplicative property of determinants to link the inverse's determinant to the original one.
examples.zh: 老师用「行列式的乘法性质」把逆矩阵的行列式与原矩阵的行列式联系起来。

collocations: apply the multiplicative property of determinants
verify the multiplicative property of determinants
use the multiplicative property of determinants for a product

words.enDefinition: A change to thresholds, p-values, or intervals to meet a chosen error criterion when analysing several hypotheses.

examples.en: The multiplicity adjustment changes the thresholds because the classroom report includes several separate tests.
examples.zh: 由于课堂报告包含多项独立列出的检验，「多重性校正」改变了各项阈值。

examples.en: We specified the multiplicity adjustment before examining the simulated comparisons of average device readings.
examples.zh: 我们在查看模拟设备平均读数的比较结果前，就指定了「多重性校正」。

words.enDefinition: A differentiation rule for composed functions that adds contributions along each dependency path.

examples.en: The multivariable chain rule combines two contributions because both coordinates of the path depend on time.
examples.zh: 这条路径的两个坐标都依赖时间，因此「多元链式法则」将两项贡献相加。

examples.en: We drew a dependency diagram before applying the multivariable chain rule to the temperature model.
examples.zh: 我们先画依赖关系图，再对温度模型应用「多元链式法则」。

collocations: diagram for the multivariable chain rule

words.enDefinition: The existence of a linear approximation whose error divided by the input displacement length tends to zero.

examples.en: Multivariable differentiability lets us approximate small height changes by a linear expression near the marked input.
examples.zh: 「多元函数可微性」让我们能在标记输入附近用线性表达式近似微小高度变化。

examples.en: We discussed why partial derivatives alone do not guarantee multivariable differentiability at the origin.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了为什么只存在偏导数还不能保证原点处的「多元函数可微性」。

words.enDefinition: The value approached by a function as its inputs tend to a point from all allowed directions.

examples.en: The multivariable limit must agree along every path in the domain approaching the marked point.
examples.zh: 沿定义域内任何趋近标记点的路径，「多元函数极限」都必须相同。

examples.en: We used an inequality to establish the multivariable limit for the example function at the origin.
examples.zh: 我们利用一个不等式确定示例函数在原点处的「多元函数极限」。

words.enDefinition: A test that uses second derivatives at a stationary point to distinguish local extrema from saddle points in decisive cases.

examples.en: The multivariable second derivative test is inconclusive here because the two-variable Hessian determinant is zero.
examples.zh: 这里的二元海森矩阵行列式为零，因此「多元二阶导数检验」无法得出结论。

examples.en: We used the multivariable second derivative test to classify the stationary point in the smooth example.
examples.zh: 我们使用「多元二阶导数检验」对光滑示例中的驻点分类。

collocations: apply the multivariable second derivative test
use the multivariable second derivative test

words.enDefinition: Full independence requiring probability factorization for every subset of the event family

examples.en: We checked probabilities for triples as well as pairs before claiming mutual independence.
examples.zh: 我们核对了三项组合以及两项组合的概率，才断定存在「相互独立」。

examples.en: Under mutual independence, the joint probability factors for any selected group of events.
examples.zh: 在「相互独立」下，任意选定一组事件的联合概率都可以分解为各自概率的乘积。

words.enDefinition: Events sharing no outcomes and therefore unable to occur together

examples.en: The worksheet treats drawing red and drawing blue as mutually exclusive events on a single draw.
examples.zh: 在单次抽取时，习题把抽到红色和抽到蓝色视为「互斥事件」。

examples.en: Our two events cannot happen together, so we classified them as mutually exclusive events.
examples.zh: 这两个事件不能同时发生，所以我们把它们划为「互斥事件」。

collocations: mutually exclusive events in one trial

words.enDefinition: Distribution of failures before a specified success count in independent identical trials

examples.en: We used a negative binomial distribution to model the number of tails before the third head.
examples.zh: 我们用「负二项分布」建模第三次出现正面前反面出现的次数。

examples.en: The negative binomial distribution in our worksheet stops when the experiment reaches a predetermined success count.
examples.zh: 习题中的「负二项分布」记录的是试验达到预先指定成功次数前的失败次数。

collocations: parameters of a negative binomial distribution
example of a negative binomial distribution

words.enDefinition: a real symmetric or complex Hermitian matrix whose quadratic form is strictly negative on every nonzero vector

examples.en: The negative definite matrix gave a negative quadratic value in every nonzero direction considered by the proof.
examples.zh: 证明讨论的每个非零方向上，「负定矩阵」的二次型值都为负。

examples.en: We checked that each eigenvalue was negative before calling the example a negative definite matrix.
examples.zh: 将示例称为「负定矩阵」前，我们核实各特征值均为负。

collocations: test whether a matrix is negative definite
compare a negative definite matrix with its negation

words.enDefinition: a real symmetric or complex Hermitian matrix whose quadratic form is never positive

examples.en: The negative semidefinite matrix could give zero or negative quadratic values but never a positive one.
examples.zh: 「半负定矩阵」的二次型值可以为零或负数，不会为正数。

examples.en: We found a nonzero vector giving zero in the negative semidefinite matrix example before discussing strict negativity.
examples.zh: 在讨论严格为负的情形前，我们在「半负定矩阵」示例中找到了使二次型为零的非零向量。

collocations: verify that a matrix is negative semidefinite
describe the null space of a negative semidefinite matrix

words.enDefinition: Composition that applies several functions inside one another in a specified order

examples.en: We recognized a nested composition because one trigonometric expression sat inside another function.
examples.zh: 由于一个三角表达式位于另一个函数内部，我们识别出了「嵌套复合」。

examples.en: To differentiate the nested composition, we worked from the outside toward the input.
examples.zh: 对「嵌套复合」求导时，我们从外向内逐层处理，直到输入变量。

collocations: chain rule for a nested composition

words.enDefinition: the result that integrating a rate of change over an interval gives the net change of its quantity

examples.en: We applied the net change theorem to find the difference between the tank's final and initial water levels.
examples.zh: 我们应用「净变化定理」求出水箱最终水位与初始水位之差。

examples.en: The net change theorem gave displacement from signed velocity even when the object reversed its direction.
examples.zh: 即使物体掉头，「净变化定理」仍能由带符号的速度求出位移。

collocations: use the net change theorem to calculate displacement

words.enDefinition: Iterative root-finding method replacing a function locally with its tangent line

examples.en: We used Newton's method to approximate a zero without solving the equation exactly.
examples.zh: 我们用「牛顿迭代法」近似求出一个零点，省去了方程的精确求解。

examples.en: The tutor showed how Newton's method can fail when the initial slope is zero.
examples.zh: 老师说明了初始点处斜率为零时，「牛顿迭代法」为什么可能失效。

collocations: start Newton's method from an initial guess

words.enDefinition: Update from the current input to where its tangent crosses the axis

examples.en: After one Newton step, the new input was closer to the root in our example.
examples.zh: 在我们的例子中，执行「牛顿迭代的一步」后，新的输入值更接近零点。

examples.en: The Newton step uses the function value and derivative at the current estimate.
examples.zh: 「牛顿迭代的一步」需要当前估计值处的函数值和导数。

words.enDefinition: the smallest positive integer power that makes a nilpotent matrix equal to zero

examples.en: The nilpotency index was three because the square was nonzero but the cube vanished in the example.
examples.zh: 示例的平方不为零而三次幂为零，因此「幂零指数」为三。

examples.en: We determined the nilpotency index from the largest Jordan block associated with the zero eigenvalue in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们根据零特征值对应的最大若尔当块确定「幂零指数」。

words.enDefinition: a square matrix some positive integer power of which equals the zero matrix

examples.en: The example nilpotent matrix had a nonzero square but became the zero matrix at the next power.
examples.zh: 示例的「幂零矩阵」平方不为零，但再取下一次幂就成为零矩阵。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why a nilpotent matrix could not have a nonzero eigenvalue in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 导师问为什么练习中的「幂零矩阵」不可能有非零特征值。

collocations: compute a power of a nilpotent matrix
show that a matrix is nilpotent

words.enDefinition: Multiplication for which changing the order of factors can change the result.

examples.en: The class illustrated noncommutative multiplication by obtaining different matrices from the same factors in opposite orders.
examples.zh: 全班把相同因子按相反顺序相乘，得出不同矩阵，用来说明「不满足交换律的乘法」。

examples.en: Our tutor gave an example of noncommutative multiplication using two small square matrices.
examples.zh: 老师用两个小方阵演示了「不满足交换律的乘法」。

words.enDefinition: Function whose output never gets smaller as the input increases

examples.en: The graph can describe a nondecreasing function even with a flat section in the middle.
examples.zh: 即使中间有一段水平线，图像仍可以对应一个「非递减函数」。

examples.en: We verified that the nondecreasing function never went down as we moved rightward.
examples.zh: 我们确认向右移动时，「非递减函数」的图像始终没有下降。

collocations: a nondecreasing function with flat sections

words.enDefinition: Point where the finite derivative fails to exist under the stated convention

examples.en: The sharp corner is a nondifferentiable point because the two one-sided derivatives differ.
examples.zh: 这个折角是一个「不可导点」，因为两侧导数不同。

examples.en: We marked the nondifferentiable point even though the original function was continuous there.
examples.zh: 尽管原函数在该点连续，我们还是标出了「不可导点」。

words.enDefinition: A linear system with at least one nonzero constant on the right-hand side.

examples.en: The example became a nonhomogeneous system when the tutor changed one right-hand side entry to five.
examples.zh: 老师把右端项中的一个分量改成五后，例题变成了「非齐次线性方程组」。

examples.en: We compared the nonhomogeneous system with the one that used the same coefficients and zero constants.
examples.zh: 我们把「非齐次线性方程组」与系数相同且常数都为零的方程组作了比较。

collocations: check consistency of a nonhomogeneous system

words.enDefinition: A systematic error that can arise when respondents differ from nonrespondents on the characteristic being estimated.

examples.en: Nonresponse bias could arise if the students with the longest commutes seldom answer the survey.
examples.zh: 如果通勤时间最长的学生很少回答问卷，就可能出现「无应答偏差」。

examples.en: We considered nonresponse bias before interpreting the average travel time in the classroom survey.
examples.zh: 我们先考虑「无应答偏差」，再解释课堂调查得到的平均出行时间。

words.enDefinition: A matrix whose numbers of rows and columns differ.

examples.en: The diagram showed a nonsquare matrix with a different number of inputs and outputs.
examples.zh: 图中显示了一个「非方阵」，它对应的输入数和输出数不同。

examples.en: Our tutor asked why the transpose of a nonsquare matrix had a different shape.
examples.zh: 老师问，为什么「非方阵」转置后形状会发生变化。

collocations: multiply a nonsquare matrix by a vector

words.enDefinition: A solution of a homogeneous linear system with at least one nonzero component.

examples.en: We found a nontrivial solution by choosing a nonzero value for one free variable.
examples.zh: 我们为一个自由变量选择非零值，找到了一个「非平凡解」。

examples.en: Our tutor checked that the nontrivial solution satisfied all the equations on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 老师核查这个「非平凡解」满足练习表上的所有方程。

words.enDefinition: Use of a normal curve to estimate binomial probabilities when conditions permit

examples.en: We compared the normal approximation to the binomial with exact binomial probabilities in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在习题中将「二项分布的正态近似」与精确的二项概率作了比较。

examples.en: The tutor checked expected success and failure counts before using the normal approximation to the binomial.
examples.zh: 老师在使用「二项分布的正态近似」前，检查了成功和失败的期望次数。

collocations: use the normal approximation to the binomial
accuracy of a normal approximation to the binomial
check conditions for the normal approximation to the binomial

words.enDefinition: Continuous bell-shaped distribution characterized by its mean and positive variance

examples.en: We fit a normal distribution to the simulated measurements for comparison with the histogram.
examples.zh: 我们用「正态分布」拟合模拟测量值，以便与直方图比较。

examples.en: In the example, increasing variance made the normal distribution wider around its mean.
examples.zh: 例子中，增加方差让「正态分布」在均值两侧变得更宽。

words.enDefinition: the equations requiring the residual of a linear least-squares problem to be orthogonal to the design matrix columns

examples.en: The normal equations emerged when we set the residual's inner product with each design column to zero.
examples.zh: 导师令残差与设计矩阵各列的内积等于零，得到了「正规方程」。

examples.en: We solved the normal equations after checking that the design matrix had independent columns in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们确认设计矩阵的列线性无关后，求解了「正规方程」。

collocations: check the normal equations for a fitted vector

words.enDefinition: Line through a point on a curve and perpendicular to its tangent

examples.en: We drew a normal line through the point where the tangent was already marked.
examples.zh: 我们通过已标出切线的点画了一条「法线」。

examples.en: The normal line is vertical here because the tangent is horizontal at the point.
examples.zh: 因为这个点的切线是水平的，所以这里的「法线」是竖直的。

words.enDefinition: The line through a smooth surface point perpendicular to the tangent plane there.

examples.en: The normal line to a surface passes through the contact point in the diagram.
examples.zh: 「曲面的法线」经过示意图中的切点。

examples.en: We wrote a normal line to a surface using the gradient at the chosen point.
examples.zh: 我们用选定点处的梯度写出一条「曲面的法线」。

collocations: equation of a normal line to a surface
find a normal line to a surface
draw the normal line to a surface

words.enDefinition: a square matrix that commutes with its conjugate transpose

examples.en: The tutor tested the normal matrix condition by comparing the two orders of multiplication with its adjoint.
examples.zh: 导师将矩阵与其伴随按两种次序相乘，检验是否满足「正规矩阵」的条件。

examples.en: We recognised a normal matrix before using a unitary basis to write it in diagonal form.
examples.zh: 我们先认定它是「正规矩阵」，再用酉基变换将其写成对角形式。

collocations: test whether a matrix is normal
give an example of a normal matrix

words.enDefinition: A nonzero vector perpendicular to a line, plane, or the tangent space at a specified point.

examples.en: We found a normal vector by taking the cross product of two independent directions in the plane.
examples.zh: 我们对平面中的两个独立方向求叉积，得到一个「法向量」。

examples.en: The normal vector points straight out of the plane represented by the worksheet equation.
examples.zh: 「法向量」垂直于练习方程表示的平面。

words.enDefinition: The assumption that specified observations, differences, or errors follow a normal distribution in a statistical method.

examples.en: The normality assumption for this paired test concerns the measured differences within each device pair.
examples.zh: 这个配对检验的「正态性假设」针对各设备配对的实测差值。

examples.en: We discussed why the normality assumption matters more for the exact small-sample result in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们讨论了为什么「正态性假设」对精确的小样本结果更加重要。

words.enDefinition: a test concluding that a series diverges when its terms fail to approach zero

examples.en: The nth-term test for divergence applied because terms of the example series approached a nonzero value.
examples.zh: 由于示例级数各项趋于非零值，适用「通项判别法」判定发散。

examples.en: We explained why the nth-term test for divergence gave no conclusion when the terms approached zero.
examples.zh: 我们解释了为什么通项趋于零时，「通项判别法」不能给出结论。

collocations: apply the nth-term test for divergence
use the nth-term test for divergence first
explain the limitation of the nth-term test for divergence

words.enDefinition: The sampling distribution of a test statistic when the null hypothesis and the test assumptions hold.

examples.en: The null distribution shows how large the statistic could be if the group means were equal.
examples.zh: 「原假设下的分布」显示两组均值相等时统计量可能取到多大的值。

examples.en: We simulated the null distribution before drawing the tail region used in the example test.
examples.zh: 我们先模拟「原假设下的分布」，再画出示例检验所用的尾部区域。

words.enDefinition: The default statistical claim used to determine the reference behaviour of a test statistic.

examples.en: The null hypothesis says that the two fictional groups have equal population mean scores.
examples.zh: 「原假设」认为，两个虚构组的总体平均成绩相等。

examples.en: We stated the null hypothesis before examining any differences in the classroom sample data.
examples.zh: 我们先写出「原假设」，再考察课堂样本数据里的差异。

words.enDefinition: The set of input vectors that a matrix sends to the zero vector.

examples.en: We described the null space by solving the system with a zero right-hand side.
examples.zh: 我们通过解右端项为零的方程组，描述了「零空间」。

examples.en: The tutor checked whether the proposed vector belonged to the null space of the matrix.
examples.zh: 老师核查所提议的向量是否属于矩阵的「零空间」。

collocations: calculate the dimension of the null space

words.enDefinition: The dimension of the null space of a matrix or linear map.

examples.en: The nullity was two because two independent parameters described the solutions of the homogeneous system.
examples.zh: 两个独立参数描述了齐次方程组的解，所以「零度」为二。

examples.en: Our tutor asked how the nullity changed after a column was added to the matrix.
examples.zh: 老师问，给矩阵增加一列后「零度」发生了什么变化。

collocations: read the nullity from the free variables

words.enDefinition: approximating an integral using values of its integrand at selected points

examples.en: The spreadsheet used numerical integration to estimate accumulated distance from the speed values supplied by the tutor.
examples.zh: 练习表用「数值积分」，根据导师提供的速率取值估算累计路程。

examples.en: We compared two methods of numerical integration after calculating different estimates from the same measurements.
examples.zh: 我们用同一批测量值算出不同估计后，比较了两种「数值积分」方法。

words.enDefinition: the effective rank of a matrix under a stated tolerance, often counting singular values above that tolerance

examples.en: The numerical rank was two after the example treated the smallest singular value as effectively zero.
examples.zh: 示例将最小奇异值视为实际为零后，「数值秩」为二。

examples.en: We checked how the numerical rank changed when the tutor set a different tolerance for small singular values.
examples.zh: 导师为小奇异值设定不同容差后，我们核查了「数值秩」怎样变化。

collocations: use a tolerance to determine numerical rank
compare numerical rank with exact rank

words.enDefinition: Function whose value is to be maximized or minimized in a problem

examples.en: The objective function gives the area of the rectangle as its width changes.
examples.zh: 「目标函数」给出长方形面积随宽度变化的情况。

examples.en: We differentiated the objective function after expressing it in just one variable.
examples.zh: 我们先把「目标函数」写成只含一个变量的式子，再对它求导。

words.enDefinition: One of the eight regions into which the three coordinate planes divide space.

examples.en: The point with three positive coordinates lies in the first octant in our drawing.
examples.zh: 图中，三个坐标都为正的点位于第一「卦限」。

examples.en: We selected the octant that contains points with negative horizontal coordinates and positive heights.
examples.zh: 我们选出包含水平坐标为负而高度为正的点的「卦限」。

words.enDefinition: A test of a joint hypothesis, such as equality across several means, without specifying which comparison accounts for rejection.

examples.en: The omnibus test asks whether all three group means are equal in the simulated example.
examples.zh: 模拟示例中的「总体检验」考察三个组均值是否全部相等。

examples.en: After the omnibus test, we examined which pairs might explain the departure in the classroom data.
examples.zh: 做完「总体检验」后，我们考察课堂数据中哪些组间配对可能解释这种偏离。

collocations: follow an omnibus test with comparisons

words.enDefinition: A large-sample test comparing one observed proportion with a specified population proportion using a standard normal reference.

examples.en: The one-proportion z-test compares the fraction of acceptable pieces with the specified target in our exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中的「单比例 z 检验」将合格零件比例与指定目标作比较。

examples.en: We checked the expected counts before using the one-proportion z-test for the simulated production sample.
examples.zh: 我们检查预期计数后，对模拟生产样本做「单比例 z 检验」。

words.zhGloss: 单样本柯尔莫哥洛夫—斯米尔诺夫检验
words.enDefinition: A goodness-of-fit test based on the greatest gap between an empirical and a fully specified reference cumulative distribution.
acceptedZhAnswers: 单样本柯尔莫哥洛夫—斯米尔诺夫检验

examples.en: The one-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test uses the largest gap between the two cumulative curves in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上的「单样本柯尔莫哥洛夫—斯米尔诺夫检验」使用两条累积分布曲线的最大间距。

examples.en: We used a one-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test with the reference distribution specified before looking at the data.
examples.zh: 我们使用「单样本柯尔莫哥洛夫—斯米尔诺夫检验」，并在查看数据前指定了参考分布。

collocations: reference distribution for a one-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test
assumptions of a one-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov test

words.enDefinition: A test of one population mean using the sample standard deviation to estimate the standard error and a t reference distribution.

examples.en: The one-sample t-test compares the mean of the sample readings with the stated reference value.
examples.zh: 「单样本 t 检验」把样本读数的均值与给定参考值作比较。

examples.en: We used a one-sample t-test after checking the assumptions for the small classroom sample.
examples.zh: 我们检查小型课堂样本是否满足假设后，使用了「单样本 t 检验」。

words.enDefinition: A test of one population mean using a standard normal reference when the population standard deviation is known under its model.

examples.en: The one-sample z-test compares the average calibration reading with the specified reference value in class.
examples.zh: 「单样本 z 检验」将课堂中的平均校准读数与指定参考值作比较。

examples.en: We used a one-sample z-test because the exercise supplied the population standard deviation and assumed normality.
examples.zh: 练习给出了总体标准差且假设总体正态，因此我们使用「单样本 z 检验」。

words.enDefinition: An upper or lower limit constructed to provide one-sided coverage for a parameter at a specified confidence level.

examples.en: The one-sided confidence bound gives only a lower limit for the population mean in our exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中的「单侧置信界」只给出总体均值的下限。

examples.en: We used a one-sided confidence bound because the worksheet asks how high the population mean might be.
examples.zh: 练习要求估计总体均值可能有多高，因此我们用了「单侧置信界」。

collocations: one-sided confidence bound for a mean

words.enDefinition: Equality of a function's one-sided limit and value at the point

examples.en: We checked one-sided continuity because the square root was defined only to the right.
examples.zh: 平方根在该点右侧才有定义，因此我们检查了「单侧连续性」。

examples.en: The definition of one-sided continuity helps us handle endpoints that have only one nearby side.
examples.zh: 「单侧连续性」的定义有助于处理只能从一侧趋近的端点。

words.enDefinition: Limit of the difference quotient when input changes approach zero from one side

examples.en: We computed a one-sided derivative at the left endpoint because the domain starts there.
examples.zh: 因为定义域从左端点开始，我们在该端点求了「单侧导数」。

examples.en: The one-sided derivative exists here although the two-sided derivative fails to exist.
examples.zh: 这里存在「单侧导数」，而双侧导数不存在。

words.enDefinition: Value approached when inputs come toward a point from only one side

examples.en: We found a one-sided limit by following only the part of the graph left of zero.
examples.zh: 我们只沿零左侧的曲线观察，求出一个「单侧极限」。

examples.en: The exercise asks for a one-sided limit at the endpoint of the domain.
examples.zh: 这道题要求求出定义域端点处的「单侧极限」。

words.enDefinition: A test whose alternative hypothesis specifies a departure in one direction only.

examples.en: The one-sided test examines whether the new process has a larger mean than the reference process.
examples.zh: 「单侧检验」考察新流程的均值是否大于参考流程的均值。

examples.en: We chose a one-sided test because the classroom question named a direction in advance.
examples.zh: 课堂题目预先指定了方向，因此我们选择「单侧检验」。

words.enDefinition: A procedure for testing whether population means are equal across levels of one grouping factor.

examples.en: The one-way analysis of variance compares mean calibration readings across three simulated methods in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中的「单因素方差分析」比较三种模拟方法的平均校准读数。

examples.en: We used one-way analysis of variance because the worksheet groups the scores by one factor.
examples.zh: 练习按一个因素将成绩分组，因此我们使用「单因素方差分析」。

collocations: perform a one-way analysis of variance
assumptions of one-way analysis of variance

words.enDefinition: Set of real numbers strictly between its two designated endpoints

examples.en: The open interval contains the points between the endpoints but excludes the endpoints themselves.
examples.zh: 「开区间」包含两个端点之间的点，端点本身不包括在内。

examples.en: We checked the derivative on the open interval before discussing the boundary points.
examples.zh: 我们先检查了「开区间」上的导数，再讨论边界点。

words.enDefinition: Task of finding the best value of a quantity under specified restrictions

examples.en: The optimization problem asks which rectangle has the largest area for a fixed perimeter.
examples.zh: 这个「优化问题」问的是，在周长固定时哪种长方形面积最大。

examples.en: We stated the optimization problem in words before writing it as a function.
examples.zh: 我们先用文字陈述「优化问题」，再把要优化的量写成函数。

words.enDefinition: The sequence in which variables are integrated in an iterated integral.

examples.en: Changing the order of integration makes the inner bounds easier to describe in this example.
examples.zh: 在这个例子中，改变「积分次序」让内层积分上下限更易表示。

examples.en: We checked the order of integration against the differentials written after the integrand on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们把「积分次序」和练习上被积函数后列出的微分逐项核对。

collocations: order of integration in a double integral

words.enDefinition: a basis whose distinct vectors have zero inner product with each other

examples.en: The orthogonal basis made each coordinate depend on only one inner product and a normalising factor.
examples.zh: 采用「正交基」后，各坐标只需一个内积和一个归一化因子就能求出。

examples.en: We checked the lengths after building an orthogonal basis because its vectors were not all unit length.
examples.zh: 建立一组「正交基」后，我们核查了向量长度，因为它们未必都是单位长度。

collocations: expand a vector in an orthogonal basis
convert an orthogonal basis into an orthonormal basis

words.enDefinition: the subspace of all vectors orthogonal to every vector in a given subspace

examples.en: We found the orthogonal complement by requiring zero inner product with each of the two basis vectors.
examples.zh: 我们要求新向量与两个基向量的内积均为零，由此求出「正交补」。

examples.en: The tutor used the orthogonal complement to describe the directions perpendicular to the plane in the example.
examples.zh: 导师用「正交补」描述示例中垂直于平面的所有方向。

collocations: compute a basis for the orthogonal complement
take the orthogonal complement of a subspace

words.enDefinition: writing a vector as the sum of its component in a subspace and its component in the orthogonal complement

examples.en: The orthogonal decomposition split the vector into a part in the plane and a perpendicular part.
examples.zh: 「正交分解」把向量分成平面内部分和与平面垂直的部分。

examples.en: We used the orthogonal decomposition to add the squared lengths of the components without cross terms.
examples.zh: 我们用「正交分解」，相加各分量长度的平方时没有交叉项。

words.enDefinition: representing a real matrix as diagonal under a change of basis made with an orthogonal matrix

examples.en: We applied orthogonal diagonalization to the symmetric matrix after normalising the two perpendicular eigenvectors in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上把两个垂直的特征向量归一化后，对这个对称矩阵作「正交对角化」。

examples.en: The orthogonal diagonalization let us preserve inner products while simplifying the action of the transformation in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，「正交对角化」在简化变换作用的同时保持内积不变。

collocations: use orthogonal diagonalization to simplify a quadratic form

words.enDefinition: a real square matrix whose transpose is its inverse

examples.en: The tutor used an orthogonal matrix to change coordinates without altering the lengths of the displayed vectors.
examples.zh: 导师用「正交矩阵」改换坐标，图示向量的长度保持不变。

examples.en: The columns had unit length and were mutually perpendicular, so the exercise matrix was an orthogonal matrix.
examples.zh: 各列的长度为一且彼此垂直，所以练习中的这个矩阵是「正交矩阵」。

collocations: check whether a matrix is an orthogonal matrix
verify the columns of an orthogonal matrix

words.enDefinition: the norm of the difference between a vector and its orthogonal projection onto a specified subspace

examples.en: The orthogonal projection error fell after we allowed the approximation to use one more direction in the example.
examples.zh: 在示例中，允许近似再使用一个方向后，「正交投影误差」减小了。

examples.en: We compared the orthogonal projection error for two candidate subspaces with the same dimension in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们比较练习表中两个维数相同的候选子空间对应的「正交投影误差」。

words.enDefinition: the vector in a subspace whose difference from the original vector is orthogonal to that subspace

examples.en: The orthogonal projection landed on the plane while the error vector pointed perpendicular to it in the sketch.
examples.zh: 草图中，「正交投影」落在平面上，误差向量垂直于该平面。

examples.en: We verified the orthogonal projection by checking that the remainder had zero inner product with each basis vector.
examples.zh: 我们检查余向量与每个基向量的内积是否为零，以验证「正交投影」。

words.enDefinition: the linear map sending every vector to its orthogonal projection onto a specified subspace

examples.en: The orthogonal projector left the plane's components unchanged and removed the perpendicular component in our example.
examples.zh: 示例中的「正交投影算子」保留平面内分量，去掉垂直分量。

examples.en: Our tutor represented the orthogonal projector by a symmetric matrix in a real orthonormal basis.
examples.zh: 导师用对称矩阵表示实标准正交基下的「正交投影算子」。

collocations: represent an orthogonal projector by a matrix

words.enDefinition: a collection of vectors whose distinct members are orthogonal to each other

examples.en: The orthogonal set contained fewer vectors than the space dimension, so it could not already form a basis.
examples.zh: 这个「正交向量组」的向量个数少于空间维数，因此尚不能构成一组基。

examples.en: We extended the orthogonal set by adding a nonzero vector perpendicular to every existing vector.
examples.zh: 我们加入一个与原有各向量垂直的非零向量，扩充了这个「正交向量组」。

collocations: check whether vectors form an orthogonal set
normalise the vectors in an orthogonal set

words.enDefinition: similarity between two real square matrices expressed using an orthogonal change of basis

examples.en: The tutor verified orthogonal similarity by finding a real basis change whose inverse equalled its transpose.
examples.zh: 导师找出一项逆矩阵等于转置矩阵的实换基变换，以验证「正交相似」。

examples.en: We used orthogonal similarity to preserve both the eigenvalues and the geometry of the coordinate space.
examples.zh: 我们通过「正交相似」既保留特征值，也保留坐标空间的几何结构。

words.enDefinition: subspaces such that every vector in one is orthogonal to every vector in the other

examples.en: The orthogonal subspaces in the exercise shared only the zero vector, even though both had positive dimension.
examples.zh: 练习中的「相互正交的子空间」尽管维数都为正，却只有零向量为它们所共有。

examples.en: We proved the two were orthogonal subspaces by testing all pairs of their basis vectors across the spaces.
examples.zh: 我们检验跨两个子空间的每一对基向量，证明它们是「相互正交的子空间」。

collocations: decompose a space into orthogonal subspaces
prove that two subspaces are orthogonal

words.enDefinition: transforming a spanning list into mutually orthogonal vectors while preserving the span

examples.en: The tutor used orthogonalisation to simplify coordinate calculations without changing the subspace in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 导师用「正交化」简化坐标计算，练习表上的子空间维持不变。

examples.en: We performed orthogonalisation before scaling each of the resulting nonzero vectors to norm one.
examples.zh: 在将所得非零向量逐个缩放到范数一以前，我们先做了「正交化」。

words.enDefinition: the relation between vectors whose inner product is zero, or subspaces whose vectors all satisfy that relation across them

examples.en: The tutor tested orthogonality by computing the inner product of the two columns in the proposed basis.
examples.zh: 导师求拟用基的两列之间的内积，以检验「正交性」。

examples.en: We checked orthogonality before adding squared lengths to calculate the squared norm of the full vector.
examples.zh: 我们先核查「正交性」，再把各长度平方相加，算出完整向量的范数平方。

words.enDefinition: a basis of mutually orthogonal vectors each of norm one

examples.en: The orthonormal basis let the tutor obtain each coordinate directly as an inner product with its basis vector.
examples.zh: 使用「标准正交基」后，导师直接与相应基向量作内积，即可得到各坐标。

examples.en: We formed an orthonormal basis after checking that each of the new vectors had length one.
examples.zh: 确认各新向量的长度均为一后，我们构造了「标准正交基」。

collocations: expand a vector in an orthonormal basis
verify that vectors form an orthonormal basis

words.enDefinition: a collection of mutually orthogonal vectors, all with norm one

examples.en: The orthonormal set had only two vectors in the three-dimensional example and did not yet form a basis.
examples.zh: 在三维示例中，这个「标准正交向量组」只有两个向量，还不构成一组基。

examples.en: The tutor extended the orthonormal set by adding a unit vector orthogonal to both existing vectors.
examples.zh: 导师加入一个与现有两个向量都正交的单位向量，以扩充「标准正交向量组」。

words.enDefinition: Break where persistent oscillation prevents a limiting value at the point

examples.en: The graph shows an oscillatory discontinuity because the oscillations never settle near zero.
examples.zh: 图像展示了「振荡间断」，因为零附近的振荡始终没有平息。

examples.en: We distinguished an oscillatory discontinuity from a jump by looking for separate one-sided limits.
examples.zh: 我们观察左右极限是否各自存在，以区分「振荡间断」和跳跃间断。

words.enDefinition: Function applied to the result produced by another function in a composition

examples.en: The outer function is a square root applied after the inner expression is evaluated.
examples.zh: 先算内层表达式，再用一个平方根作为「外层函数」。

examples.en: We took the derivative of the outer function before substituting the inside expression.
examples.zh: 我们先求「外层函数」的导数，再代入内层表达式。

words.enDefinition: An integral evaluated after its inner integral, using the resulting function as its integrand.

examples.en: The outer integral adds contributions from all the slices in the classroom volume example.
examples.zh: 课堂体积示例中的「外层积分」将所有切片的贡献累加。

examples.en: We evaluated the outer integral after simplifying the expression left by the first integration.
examples.zh: 我们化简第一次积分的结果后，再求「外层积分」。

words.enDefinition: The matrix formed by multiplying a column vector by a row vector.

examples.en: We formed an outer product from a column of quantities and a row of conversion factors.
examples.zh: 我们用一列数量和一行换算系数形成「外积」。

examples.en: The outer product had one row for each entry of the column vector we started with.
examples.zh: 原列向量的每个元素都对应「外积」的一行。

collocations: express a matrix as an outer product
inspect an entry of the outer product

words.enDefinition: A normal vector of length one pointing outside the solid at a smooth boundary point.

examples.en: The outward unit normal points away from the centre of the sphere in the exercise.
examples.zh: 在练习中，「单位外法向量」背离球心。

examples.en: We selected the outward unit normal before evaluating the flux through the closed surface.
examples.zh: 求闭曲面上的通量之前，我们先选定「单位外法向量」。

collocations: dot with the outward unit normal

words.enDefinition: an infinite series summing reciprocals of positive integers raised to a fixed real power p

examples.en: The tutor compared two p-series by checking whether their exponents were above or below one.
examples.zh: 导师检查两个「p 级数」的指数各自大于还是小于一，以比较它们。

examples.en: We identified a p-series after rewriting each term as one divided by the index squared.
examples.zh: 我们把各项写成下标平方的倒数，认定它是一个「p 级数」。

collocations: compare a series with a p-series

words.enDefinition: The probability, under the null model, of a test statistic at least as extreme as the observed statistic.

examples.en: The p-value includes outcomes at least as extreme as the observed statistic under the null model.
examples.zh: 「p 值」是在原假设模型下，统计量至少与观测值同样极端的概率。

examples.en: We computed the p-value from both tails because the alternative was two-sided in this exercise.
examples.zh: 由于这项练习采用双侧备择假设，我们从两侧尾部计算「p 值」。

words.enDefinition: The subtraction of two observations that belong to the same matched pair, in a consistent order across pairs.

examples.en: We calculated a paired difference for each weighing device using the second reading minus the first.
examples.zh: 我们用第二次读数减第一次读数，为每台称重设备计算「配对差值」。

examples.en: The paired difference is negative for the device that produced a lower reading on remeasurement.
examples.zh: 重新测量后读数较低的那台设备，其「配对差值」为负。

words.enDefinition: Observations linked in pairs by a common unit or a matching rule and analysed through their pairing.

examples.en: The paired observations come from the same simulated device measured before and after adjustment in class.
examples.zh: 这组「配对观测值」来自课堂同一模拟设备调整前后的测量。

examples.en: We kept the recorded identifiers so the paired observations could be lined up correctly for analysis.
examples.zh: 我们保留了记录的标识符，让「配对观测值」在分析时能正确对应。

words.enDefinition: A one-sample t-test applied to the within-pair differences of matched observations.

examples.en: The paired t-test uses the change in each device's reading before and after adjustment in our exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中的「配对 t 检验」使用各台设备调整前后读数的变化。

examples.en: We checked the differences for unusual values before carrying out the paired t-test in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先检查差值有没有异常值，再做「配对 t 检验」。

words.enDefinition: Independence of each pair within a specified family of events

examples.en: To check pairwise independence, we compared each pair's joint probability with the product of its probabilities.
examples.zh: 为检查「两两独立」，我们将每一对事件的联合概率与各自概率的乘积作了比较。

examples.en: Our example shows pairwise independence even though the probability of all three fails to factor.
examples.zh: 尽管三个事件同时发生的概率不能分解为各自概率的乘积，本例中仍有「两两独立」。

words.enDefinition: Equations that express each coordinate of a line as a linear function of a common parameter.

examples.en: The parametric equations of a line list one coordinate expression for each of the three axes.
examples.zh: 「直线的参数方程」为三个坐标轴各列出一个坐标表达式。

examples.en: We substituted a parameter value into the parametric equations of a line to locate one point.
examples.zh: 我们将一个参数值代入「直线的参数方程」，确定了一个点的位置。

collocations: write the parametric equations of a line
solve the parametric equations of a line
convert the parametric equations of a line

words.enDefinition: A solution set written as a fixed vector plus linear combinations of direction vectors with free parameters.

examples.en: We wrote the solution in parametric vector form to show how each free variable changed the result.
examples.zh: 我们把解写成「参数向量形式」，展示每个自由变量怎样改变结果。

examples.en: The tutor checked the fixed vector and both direction vectors in our parametric vector form.
examples.zh: 老师核查了我们「参数向量形式」中的固定向量和两个方向向量。

collocations: write a solution in parametric vector form
convert a description to parametric vector form

words.enDefinition: A curve described by a vector-valued function of a parameter over a specified interval.

examples.en: The parametrized curve starts at the marked point and moves clockwise as the parameter increases.
examples.zh: 这条「参数化曲线」从标记点出发，随参数增大按顺时针方向前进。

examples.en: We drew arrows on the parametrized curve to show its direction in the geometry exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在几何练习的「参数化曲线」上画箭头，标出它的方向。

words.enDefinition: A surface represented by a vector-valued function of two parameters ranging over a plane region.

examples.en: The parametrized surface uses two angles to describe points on a portion of the sphere.
examples.zh: 这张「参数化曲面」用两个角描述球面一部分上的点。

examples.en: We drew a grid on the parametrized surface by holding one parameter fixed at a time.
examples.zh: 我们每次固定一个参数，在「参数化曲面」上画出网格。

words.enDefinition: The derivative with respect to one variable while the other independent variables are held fixed.

examples.en: The partial derivative with respect to time uses a fixed location on the modelled plate.
examples.zh: 对时间求「偏导数」时，模型金属板上的位置保持固定。

examples.en: We interpreted the partial derivative by looking at a vertical slice through the surface.
examples.zh: 我们观察穿过曲面的竖直截面，以解释「偏导数」。

collocations: partial derivative with respect to a variable

words.enDefinition: rewriting a proper rational function as a sum of simpler fractions determined by its denominator's factors

examples.en: We used partial fraction decomposition to separate the rational expression before integrating its terms one at a time.
examples.zh: 我们用「部分分式分解」拆开有理式，再逐项积分。

examples.en: The tutor checked the partial fraction decomposition by putting the terms back over a common denominator.
examples.zh: 导师把各项重新通分，以核查「部分分式分解」。

words.enDefinition: the sum of the first several terms of a series up to a specified index

examples.en: The tenth partial sum added the first ten terms of the series in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中的第十个「部分和」加总了该级数的前十项。

examples.en: We compared one partial sum with the next to see how much the newest term changed it.
examples.zh: 我们比较一个「部分和」与下一个部分和，观察新增一项使它改变了多少。

collocations: approximate a series with a partial sum

words.enDefinition: One specific solution of a system, used as a starting point for describing all solutions.

examples.en: We found a particular solution by setting the free variables to zero in the consistent example.
examples.zh: 我们在相容的例题中将自由变量设为零，得到一个「特解」。

examples.en: The tutor checked the particular solution before adding the possible homogeneous solutions to it.
examples.zh: 老师核查了「特解」，才将齐次方程组的各种解与它相加。

collocations: add a homogeneous solution to a particular solution

words.enDefinition: a finite ordered set of points that divides a closed interval into smaller subintervals

examples.en: The partition of an interval used unequal widths to place more sample points near the sharp bend.
examples.zh: 「区间的分割」使用不等宽小区间，使尖锐弯折附近有更多取样点。

examples.en: We changed the partition of an interval by inserting one more point between the two endpoints.
examples.zh: 我们在两个端点之间再插入一点，从而更改了「区间的分割」。

collocations: choose a partition of an interval
refine a partition of an interval
construct a partition of an interval

words.enDefinition: Collection of disjoint nonempty events covering every possible outcome exactly once

examples.en: Grouping rolls into even and odd outcomes gives a partition of the sample space in our example.
examples.zh: 在我们的例子中，将掷骰结果按奇偶分组，就形成了「样本空间的划分」。

examples.en: We used a partition of the sample space so each possible result belonged to exactly one group.
examples.zh: 我们对「样本空间进行划分」，使每一种可能的结果都恰好属于一个组。

collocations: form a partition of the sample space
choose a partition of the sample space
check a partition of the sample space

words.enDefinition: a point of a partition marking a boundary between subintervals or at the ends of the full interval

examples.en: The tutor added a partition point halfway between the two existing marks on the exercise's number line.
examples.zh: 导师在练习数轴上的两个现有标记之间正中位置加入了一个「分割点」。

examples.en: We moved a partition point to make the narrow subinterval cover the steepest part of the graph.
examples.zh: 我们移动一个「分割点」，让较窄的子区间覆盖图中最陡的部分。

collocations: use an endpoint as a partition point

words.enDefinition: The property that a line integral of a vector field depends only on its endpoints.

examples.en: Path independence lets us choose a simpler route between the two marked endpoints in the exercise.
examples.zh: 「路径无关性」让我们能在练习标出的两个端点之间选择一条更简单的路线。

examples.en: We tested path independence by looking for a potential function on the specified domain.
examples.zh: 我们在给定定义域上寻找势函数，以检验「路径无关性」。

collocations: path independence of a line integral

words.enDefinition: In count tables, the observed count minus its expected count, divided by the square root of the expected count.

examples.en: The Pearson residual is positive when a cell has more observations than the model expects.
examples.zh: 某单元格的观测频数大于模型预期时，「皮尔逊残差」为正。

examples.en: We examined each Pearson residual to identify the largest departures in the classroom table.
examples.zh: 我们查看各个「皮尔逊残差」，找出课堂表格中偏离最大的单元格。

words.enDefinition: A confidence interval that uses chosen lower and upper quantiles of the bootstrap estimates as its endpoints.

examples.en: The percentile bootstrap interval takes both endpoints directly from the distribution of the resampled medians.
examples.zh: 「百分位自助法区间」直接从重抽样中位数的分布中取得两个端点。

examples.en: We plotted the percentile bootstrap interval after sorting the estimates from all the classroom resamples.
examples.zh: 我们对课堂各重抽样估计值排序后，画出了「百分位自助法区间」。

collocations: percentile bootstrap interval for a median

words.enDefinition: Ordered arrangement of selected elements from the given collection

examples.en: Changing the first two letters gives a different permutation in this example.
examples.zh: 在这个例子中，调换前两个字母就得到一种不同的「排列」。

examples.en: We listed each permutation of the three labeled books on the shelf.
examples.zh: 我们列出了书架上三本有标记的书可能出现的每种「排列」。

words.enDefinition: The distribution of a statistic over the rearrangements permitted under a permutation test's null hypothesis.

examples.en: The permutation distribution contains the group mean difference for each valid arrangement of labels in class.
examples.zh: 课堂的「置换分布」包含每种有效标签排列对应的组均值差。

examples.en: We compared our observed difference with the tails of the permutation distribution in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习时，我们将观测差异与「置换分布」的尾部作比较。

words.enDefinition: A square matrix obtained by rearranging the rows or columns of an identity matrix.

examples.en: The example used a permutation matrix to change the order of the rows in one product.
examples.zh: 例题用「置换矩阵」改变某个乘积的行顺序。

examples.en: We checked that the permutation matrix had exactly one entry equal to one in each column.
examples.zh: 我们核查了「置换矩阵」每列恰有一个元素等于一。

collocations: swap rows using a permutation matrix

words.enDefinition: A test that compares an observed statistic with values obtained by allowable rearrangements under the null hypothesis.

examples.en: The permutation test rearranges the group labels while holding the classroom readings fixed in the example.
examples.zh: 示例的「置换检验」重新排列组标签，同时保持课堂读数不变。

examples.en: We explained which rearrangements the permutation test allows before counting values as extreme as the result.
examples.zh: 我们先说明「置换检验」允许哪些重排，再统计至少与结果同样极端的数值。

words.enDefinition: Distinct orderings of a collection containing indistinguishable copies of some elements

examples.en: We divided by two when counting permutations with repeated elements because two letters were identical.
examples.zh: 计算「有重复元素的排列」时，由于两个字母相同，我们把排列数除以二。

examples.en: The worksheet uses permutations with repeated elements to count the possible orders of identical colored tiles.
examples.zh: 习题用「有重复元素的排列」统计有些牌颜色相同的情况下各种可能顺序。

collocations: formula for permutations with repeated elements

words.enDefinition: Function given by different formulas on different parts of its domain

examples.en: We graphed a piecewise-defined function that uses a different formula on each side of zero.
examples.zh: 我们画了一个「分段定义的函数」的图像，该函数在零的两侧采用不同公式。

examples.en: At the boundary of a piecewise-defined function, check which formula includes the endpoint.
examples.zh: 在「分段定义的函数」的分段边界，要查看哪个公式包含这个端点。

words.enDefinition: A column whose index corresponds to a pivot position in an echelon form.

examples.en: We selected each pivot column from the original matrix to form a basis for its column space.
examples.zh: 我们从原矩阵取出每个「主元列」，用来组成它的列空间的一组基。

examples.en: The tutor marked the pivot column before asking which variable it represented in the system.
examples.zh: 老师先标出「主元列」，再问它在方程组中代表哪个变量。

words.enDefinition: A position corresponding to a leading entry in an echelon form of the matrix.

examples.en: In this example the first pivot position was in column two because column one contained zeros.
examples.zh: 在这个例子中，第一列全是零，因此第一个「主元位置」在第二列。

examples.en: We marked each pivot position before counting how many independent constraints the system imposed.
examples.zh: 我们先标出各「主元位置」，再统计该系统有多少独立约束。

words.enDefinition: An unknown corresponding to a pivot column of the coefficient matrix.

examples.en: The tutor expressed each pivot variable in terms of the remaining unknowns in the worked example.
examples.zh: 老师在例题中把每个「主元变量」表示为其余未知量的函数。

examples.en: We checked which pivot variable appeared in the second equation after elimination.
examples.zh: 我们查看了消元后第二个方程里出现了哪个「主元变量」。

collocations: write a pivot variable in terms of free variables

words.enDefinition: A coordinate value where a plane meets a coordinate axis at a single point.

examples.en: The worksheet finds a plane intercept by setting the other two coordinates equal to zero.
examples.zh: 练习把另外两个坐标设为零，求一个「平面的截距」。

examples.en: We checked the sign of each plane intercept before drawing the plane through the three axes.
examples.zh: 我们先核对各个「平面的截距」的正负，再画出与三条轴相交的平面。

words.enDefinition: A preselected weighted comparison of group means, with weights summing to zero.

examples.en: The planned contrast compares the average of two group means with a reference group's mean.
examples.zh: 「预设对比」将两个组均值的平均值与参考组均值比较。
