examples.en: We specified the planned contrast before looking at the observed differences in the classroom measurements.
examples.zh: 我们在查看课堂测量的观测差异前，就确定了「预设对比」。

words.enDefinition: An estimator that replaces unknown quantities in a parameter formula with estimates or sample analogues.

examples.en: The plug-in estimator substitutes the sample proportions into the formula for the target quantity in our exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中的「代入估计量」把样本比例代入目标量的公式。

examples.en: We formed a plug-in estimator after finding a suitable estimate for each unknown input.
examples.zh: 我们为各个未知输入找到合适的估计后，构造了一个「代入估计量」。

collocations: plug-in estimator for a function of parameters

words.enDefinition: The particular numerical estimate obtained by applying a point estimator to observed data.

examples.en: The point estimate changes when we draw a new sample from the same fictional population.
examples.zh: 从同一虚构总体重新抽样时，「点估计值」会变化。

examples.en: We reported the point estimate beside the interval to distinguish the single value from the range.
examples.zh: 我们将「点估计值」与区间并列报告，区分单个数值和数值范围。

words.enDefinition: A rule that uses sample data to produce one numerical estimate of a parameter.

examples.en: The point estimator takes each classroom sample and returns a single value for the population mean.
examples.zh: 「点估计量」对每个课堂样本都给出一个总体均值的数值估计。

examples.en: We compared two formulas to decide which point estimator varied less across the repeated samples.
examples.zh: 我们比较两种公式，确定哪一个「点估计量」在重复抽样中的波动较小。

words.enDefinition: Positive probability assigned to one particular value in a distribution

examples.en: The distribution has a point mass at zero because some arrivals wait no time.
examples.zh: 分布在零处有「点质量」，因为一些到达者无需等待。

examples.en: The jump in the cumulative distribution function equals the point mass at that value.
examples.zh: 累积分布函数在该取值处的跳跃大小等于这里的「点质量」。

words.enDefinition: A plane equation stating that displacement from a fixed point in the plane is perpendicular to a normal vector.

examples.en: We wrote the plane in point-normal form using the given point and the perpendicular vector.
examples.zh: 我们利用给定点和垂直向量，把平面方程写成「点法式」。

examples.en: The point-normal form makes it easy to substitute a point and check whether it lies in the plane.
examples.zh: 用「点法式」可以方便地代入一个点，检查它是否位于平面内。

collocations: write a plane in point-normal form

words.enDefinition: Input where a function fails to be continuous under the stated convention

examples.en: We marked the point of discontinuity where the graph jumps from one height to another.
examples.zh: 我们标出了图像从一个高度跳到另一个高度的「间断点」。

examples.en: The student located a point of discontinuity by comparing the closed dot with the approached value.
examples.zh: 这名学生比较实心点的值和函数趋近的值，找到了「间断点」。

words.enDefinition: The shortest Euclidean distance from a point to any point on a line.

examples.en: The point-to-line distance is measured along the segment perpendicular to the line in our example.
examples.zh: 示例中的「点到直线的距离」沿垂直于直线的线段测得。

examples.en: We computed the point-to-line distance using the area of the parallelogram formed by two vectors.
examples.zh: 我们利用两个向量所成平行四边形的面积，计算「点到直线的距离」。

words.enDefinition: The shortest Euclidean distance from a point to a plane, measured along a perpendicular.

examples.en: The point-to-plane distance is the length of the perpendicular segment in the geometry diagram.
examples.zh: 「点到平面的距离」是几何图中垂线段的长度。

examples.en: We used a normal vector to calculate the point-to-plane distance for the point above the surface.
examples.zh: 我们用法向量算出了该「点到平面的距离」。

words.enDefinition: Approximation of many independent rare successes by a Poisson count distribution

examples.en: We used a Poisson approximation to the binomial when individual successes were rare and trials were numerous.
examples.zh: 当单次成功概率很低且试验次数很多时，我们使用了「二项分布的泊松近似」。

examples.en: The Poisson approximation to the binomial uses the expected success count as the mean of the approximating distribution.
examples.zh: 「二项分布的泊松近似」以期望成功次数作为泊松分布的均值。

collocations: use a Poisson approximation to the binomial
derive the Poisson approximation to the binomial
accuracy of the Poisson approximation to the binomial

words.enDefinition: A distribution on nonnegative integer counts whose probabilities are proportional to the mean raised to the count divided by the count factorial.

examples.en: The example uses a Poisson distribution for the count of arrivals within a fixed interval.
examples.zh: 该例用「泊松分布」表示在固定区间内观察到的到达次数。

examples.en: The mean and variance of a Poisson distribution both equal its parameter.
examples.zh: 「泊松分布」的均值和方差都等于其参数。

words.enDefinition: Constant-rate counting process with independent increments and Poisson counts in each interval

examples.en: We modeled arrivals as a Poisson process with a constant average rate over time.
examples.zh: 我们将到达建模为平均到达率随时间保持不变的「泊松过程」。

examples.en: In the Poisson process, counts in disjoint intervals have independent probability distributions.
examples.zh: 在「泊松过程」中，不相交区间的计数在概率上相互独立。

collocations: model arrivals as a Poisson process

words.enDefinition: The area differential in plane polar coordinates, containing the radial factor from the coordinate change.

examples.en: The polar area element contains an extra radial factor that grows farther from the origin.
examples.zh: 「极坐标面积微元」含有额外的径向因子，离原点越远该因子越大。

examples.en: We included the polar area element when setting up the double integral over the circular region.
examples.zh: 建立圆形区域上的二重积分时，我们写入了「极坐标面积微元」。

collocations: radial factor in the polar area element

words.enDefinition: The combined success count divided by the combined sample size, used to estimate a common proportion under a null hypothesis.

examples.en: The pooled proportion uses both samples because the null hypothesis gives them a common success probability.
examples.zh: 「合并比例」使用两个样本，因为原假设赋予两者相同的成功概率。

examples.en: We calculated the pooled proportion before computing the null standard error in the classroom exercise.
examples.zh: 课堂练习中，我们先算「合并比例」，再算原假设下的标准误。

words.zhGloss: 合并方差 t 检验
words.enDefinition: An independent-samples t-test that estimates a common population variance by pooling the two sample variances.
acceptedZhAnswers: 合并方差 t 检验

examples.en: The pooled-variance t-test uses a common variance estimate for the two groups on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习纸上的「合并方差 t 检验」为两组使用同一个方差估计值。

examples.en: We discussed the equal variance assumption before applying a pooled-variance t-test to the classroom data.
examples.zh: 将「合并方差 t 检验」应用于课堂数据前，我们先讨论了等方差假设。

words.enDefinition: A numerical characteristic of a population that a statistical analysis seeks to describe or estimate.

examples.en: The population parameter in our example is the true average travel time for all students.
examples.zh: 示例中的「总体参数」是全体学生真实的平均出行时间。

examples.en: We treated the population parameter as fixed while repeating the simulated sampling exercise in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上反复进行模拟抽样时，我们把「总体参数」视为固定值。

words.enDefinition: Function giving the location of a moving object at each time

examples.en: The position function gives the cart's location relative to its starting marker along the track.
examples.zh: 「位置函数」给出小车沿轨道相对于起始标记的位置。

examples.en: We differentiated the position function to find when the motion changed direction in this example.
examples.zh: 在这个例子中，我们对「位置函数」求导，来确定运动何时改变方向。

words.enDefinition: The vector from the coordinate origin to a specified point.

examples.en: The position vector starts at the origin and ends at the marked point above the plane.
examples.zh: 「位置向量」起于原点，终点是平面上方的标记点。

examples.en: We wrote the position vector for each point along the rising curve in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们写出了练习中上升曲线上各点的「位置向量」。

words.enDefinition: A boundary direction consistent with the region's orientation, counterclockwise for the outer boundary of a standard plane region.

examples.en: The positive boundary orientation keeps the shaded disk on our left as we trace its edge.
examples.zh: 我们沿「边界的正向取向」绕阴影圆盘走时，圆盘始终在左侧。

examples.en: We checked the positive boundary orientation before applying the planar integral theorem in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先核对「边界的正向取向」，再应用平面积分定理。

words.enDefinition: a real symmetric or complex Hermitian matrix whose quadratic form is strictly positive for every nonzero vector

examples.en: The positive definite matrix assigned positive quadratic values to every nonzero vector tested in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习表中，「正定矩阵」对所检验的每一个非零向量都给出正的二次型值。

examples.en: We proved it was a positive definite matrix by showing that all its eigenvalues were strictly positive.
examples.zh: 我们证明各特征值严格为正，由此证明它是「正定矩阵」。

collocations: test whether a matrix is positive definite

words.enDefinition: a real symmetric or complex Hermitian matrix whose quadratic form never has a negative value

examples.en: The positive semidefinite matrix had one zero eigenvalue, so its quadratic form could vanish for nonzero vectors.
examples.zh: 这个「半正定矩阵」有一个零特征值，因此其二次型对某些非零向量可以为零。

examples.en: We showed the Gram matrix was a positive semidefinite matrix by expressing the form as a squared norm.
examples.zh: 我们把二次型写成范数的平方，证明格拉姆矩阵是「半正定矩阵」。

collocations: show that a matrix is positive semidefinite

words.enDefinition: A follow-up comparison selected after examining the data or results of an overall test, often with adjustment for multiple comparisons.

examples.en: The post hoc comparison examines two production methods after the overall test shows differences among the means.
examples.zh: 总体检验发现均值存在差异后，「事后比较」进一步考察其中两种生产方法。

examples.en: We recorded the adjustment used for each post hoc comparison in the classroom results table.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂结果表里记录了每项「事后比较」所用的校正方法。

words.enDefinition: Probability of a hypothesis conditional on the evidence that has been observed

examples.en: The posterior probability favored the larger bag after we observed a red tile.
examples.zh: 看到一块红牌后，「后验概率」显示牌来自较大袋子的可能性更高。

examples.en: We compared the posterior probability with its original value before seeing the evidence.
examples.zh: 我们将「后验概率」与看到这一证据前的概率作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A scalar function whose gradient equals a given vector field.

examples.en: The potential function has the assigned vector field as its gradient throughout the example domain.
examples.zh: 在整个示例定义域上，「势函数」的梯度等于指定向量场。

examples.en: We found the potential function and then evaluated it at both endpoints of the path.
examples.zh: 我们求出「势函数」，然后计算路径两个端点处的势函数值。

words.enDefinition: An analysis linking a statistical test's power to sample size, variability, significance level, and effect size.

examples.en: The power analysis helps the class choose a sample size for a specified difference in means.
examples.zh: 「功效分析」帮助全班为指定均值差选择样本量。

examples.en: We repeated the power analysis with greater assumed variability to see how the sample requirement changed.
examples.zh: 我们在假设变异更大的情况下重做「功效分析」，查看所需样本量如何变化。

words.enDefinition: A graph showing how the probability of rejection changes across alternative parameter values for a given test design.

examples.en: The power curve shows that larger departures are easier to detect with the same classroom test.
examples.zh: 「功效曲线」显示，在同样的课堂检验下，较大的偏离更容易检测到。

examples.en: We used the power curve to compare two designs across a range of possible differences.
examples.zh: 我们用「功效曲线」比较两种设计在一系列可能差异下的表现。

words.enDefinition: an iterative method estimating a dominant eigenvector by repeatedly multiplying by the matrix and rescaling

examples.en: The power iteration gradually aligned the starting vector with the matrix's dominant eigenvector in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，「幂迭代」逐渐使起始向量对准矩阵主特征向量的方向。

examples.en: We chose a starting vector for power iteration with a nonzero component along the dominant direction.
examples.zh: 我们为「幂迭代」选择了沿主方向有非零分量的起始向量。

collocations: choose an initial vector for power iteration

words.enDefinition: a trigonometric identity rewriting a power of a sine or cosine in terms of lower powers

examples.en: The power-reduction identity replaced the squared cosine with two terms that were easier to integrate separately.
examples.zh: 「降幂恒等式」将余弦平方改写成两项，使每一项更容易积分。

examples.en: We wrote a power-reduction identity before integrating the expression containing an even power of sine.
examples.zh: 积分含正弦偶次幂的表达式前，我们先写出一条「降幂恒等式」。

collocations: rewrite a square with a power-reduction identity

words.enDefinition: Differentiation rule multiplying by the exponent and reducing the exponent by one

examples.en: We used the power rule to differentiate the cube of the input variable.
examples.zh: 我们用「幂函数求导法则」对输入变量的三次幂求导。

examples.en: The tutor applied the power rule separately to each power in the polynomial.
examples.zh: 老师对多项式里的每个幂分别应用「幂函数求导法则」。

words.enDefinition: a series whose terms are coefficient multiples of successive nonnegative powers of a variable minus a fixed centre

examples.en: We wrote a power series using powers of the variable minus the centre specified on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们用变量减去练习表所指定中心的差的各次幂表示「幂级数」。

examples.en: The given power series converged for small input values but failed to converge at a more distant point.
examples.zh: 给出的「幂级数」对较小的自变量值收敛，但在较远的一点不收敛。

collocations: find where a power series converges
represent a function by a power series

words.enDefinition: the multiplier of a specified power in a power series

examples.en: The power series coefficient of the cubic term was zero in the function with only even powers.
examples.zh: 这个函数的级数只有偶次幂，三次项的「幂级数系数」为零。

examples.en: We found each power series coefficient by expanding the product and collecting the terms of that degree.
examples.zh: 我们展开乘积并合并对应次数的项，求得各个「幂级数系数」。

collocations: find a power series coefficient of a given degree

words.enDefinition: The importance or usefulness of the estimated magnitude in the problem's real context.

examples.en: The class considered practical significance by comparing the small estimated difference with normal device variation.
examples.zh: 全班将估计得到的小差异与设备正常波动比较，以考虑其「实际意义」。

examples.en: We discussed practical significance even when the sample was large enough to detect a tiny difference.
examples.zh: 即便样本大到足以检测微小差异，我们也讨论了差异的「实际意义」。

words.enDefinition: An interval designed to contain a future observation of the specified kind with a stated probability under the model.

examples.en: The prediction interval is wider here because the next observation can vary around the population mean.
examples.zh: 这个「预测区间」更宽，因为下一个观测值还会围绕总体均值波动。

examples.en: We compared a prediction interval for tomorrow's reading with a confidence interval for the average.
examples.zh: 我们比较了明天读数的「预测区间」和平均值的置信区间。

collocations: prediction interval for a new observation

words.enDefinition: Derivative notation adding one or more marks to the function's symbol

examples.en: We used prime notation to label the first and second derivatives on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们用「撇号记法」标注习题表中的一阶和二阶导数。

examples.en: In prime notation, a pair of marks indicates the second derivative in this example.
examples.zh: 在这个例子中，按「撇号记法」加两个撇号表示二阶导数。

collocations: express a derivative in prime notation

words.enDefinition: The unit vector in the direction of the arc-length derivative of the unit tangent when that derivative is nonzero.

examples.en: The principal normal vector points toward the inside of the curve's turn at the marked point.
examples.zh: 在曲线的标记点，「主法向量」指向转弯的内侧。

examples.en: We found the principal normal vector after determining how the unit tangent changes along the curve.
examples.zh: 我们确定单位切向量沿曲线如何变化后，求出「主法向量」。

collocations: principal normal vector to a curve
direction of the principal normal vector

words.enDefinition: Probability assigned to a hypothesis before the specified evidence is taken into account

examples.en: The prior probability of choosing the first bag comes from the original selection rule.
examples.zh: 选择第一个袋子的「先验概率」由最初的选择规则给出。

examples.en: We wrote the prior probability before looking at the color of the selected tile.
examples.zh: 我们在看抽中的牌的颜色之前，先写下了「先验概率」。

words.enDefinition: Nonnegative function whose integral gives probabilities over intervals for a continuous variable

examples.en: We integrated the probability density function between two times to find the chance of waiting that long.
examples.zh: 我们在两个时刻之间对「概率密度函数」积分，求出等待时间落在两者之间的概率。

examples.en: The probability density function reaches above one here, but its total area is one.
examples.zh: 这里的「概率密度函数」取值超过一，但总面积为一。

words.enDefinition: Specification of how probability is allocated across the values of a variable

examples.en: We wrote the probability distribution for the count of heads in three tosses.
examples.zh: 我们写出了三次抛掷中正面出现次数的「概率分布」。

examples.en: The probability distribution changed after we switched from counts to waiting times in class.
examples.zh: 在课堂中，我们从次数改为等待时间后，「概率分布」发生了变化。

words.enDefinition: Expected power of the argument with a nonnegative integer variable as exponent

examples.en: The coefficients of the probability generating function give the probabilities for the possible counts.
examples.zh: 「概率生成函数」的各个系数给出了各可能计数的概率。

examples.en: We evaluated the probability generating function at one to check that its coefficients summed correctly.
examples.zh: 我们在一处求「概率生成函数」的值，核查各系数之和是否正确。

collocations: probability generating function for a count

words.enDefinition: Function giving the probability of each individual value of a discrete variable

examples.en: We checked that the values of the probability mass function summed to one in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们检查了习题中的「概率质量函数」各个值的总和是否为一。

examples.en: The probability mass function assigns larger values to middle counts in this example.
examples.zh: 在这个例子中，「概率质量函数」为中间的计数赋予了更高的概率。

words.enDefinition: A sample selected by a design in which every population unit has a known or calculable positive probability of selection.

examples.en: The exercise uses a probability sample so each household has a known chance of selection.
examples.zh: 练习使用「概率样本」，使每户家庭被抽中的概率已知。

examples.en: We discussed why a probability sample helps the analyst account for the design when estimating uncertainty.
examples.zh: 我们讨论为什么「概率样本」有助于分析者在估计不确定性时考虑抽样设计。

words.enDefinition: Rule adding two products, each differentiating one factor and keeping the other

examples.en: We applied the product rule for derivatives to a product containing a polynomial and a sine function.
examples.zh: 我们对一个由多项式和正弦函数相乘的式子用了「积的求导法则」。

examples.en: The product rule for derivatives requires a term for the derivative of each factor in turn.
examples.zh: 「积的求导法则」要求依次为每个因子的导数写一项。

collocations: apply the product rule for derivatives
prove the product rule for derivatives
use the product rule for derivatives

words.enDefinition: a square matrix for a linear projection, satisfying the property that applying it twice equals applying it once

examples.en: The projection matrix returned the same vector after the second multiplication because the first result was already projected.
examples.zh: 第一次相乘的结果已经投影，因此「投影矩阵」第二次相乘返回同一向量。

examples.en: We checked that the projection matrix left the vectors in its target subspace unchanged in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们核查练习中的「投影矩阵」作用于目标子空间内的向量时，是否保持它们不变。

collocations: verify that a projection matrix is idempotent

words.enDefinition: The plane region reached by projecting all points of a solid onto a given plane.

examples.en: The projection of a solid onto the horizontal plane is a disk in this example.
examples.zh: 示例中，这个「立体的投影」在水平面上是一个圆盘。

examples.en: We used the projection of a solid to set the outer bounds of the triple integral.
examples.zh: 我们用「立体的投影」确定三重积分的外层上下限。

collocations: find the projection of a solid
sketch a projection of a solid
projection of a solid onto a plane

words.enDefinition: the projection onto a one-dimensional subspace spanned by one nonzero vector

examples.en: The projection onto a line found the component of the force vector along the chosen direction.
examples.zh: 「向直线的投影」找出了力向量在指定方向上的分量。

examples.en: We computed the projection onto a line before using the perpendicular component in the second part.
examples.zh: 我们先计算「向直线的投影」，再在第二部分用垂直分量。

collocations: compute the projection onto a line
draw the projection onto a line
verify the projection onto a line

words.enDefinition: the original vector minus its projection onto a specified subspace

examples.en: The projection residual was perpendicular to the plane because we used the orthogonal projection in this exercise.
examples.zh: 练习使用的是正交投影，所以「投影残差」垂直于平面。

examples.en: We calculated the projection residual to measure how much of the input remained outside the fitted subspace.
examples.zh: 我们计算「投影残差」，衡量输入有多少成分落在拟合子空间之外。

collocations: check orthogonality of a projection residual
compare the norms of two projection residuals

words.enDefinition: the result that orthogonal projection onto a finite-dimensional subspace gives the unique closest vector in that subspace

examples.en: The projection theorem showed why moving away from the projected point only increased the distance in our example.
examples.zh: 「投影定理」说明了示例中为何离开投影点只会使距离增大。

examples.en: Our tutor used the projection theorem to justify the nearest point computed on the plane in class.
examples.zh: 导师用「投影定理」说明课堂上所求的点确实是平面内的最近点。

collocations: find a closest vector using the projection theorem

words.enDefinition: A subspace that is strictly smaller than its ambient vector space.

examples.en: The constant polynomials form a proper subspace of the polynomials of degree at most two.
examples.zh: 常数多项式构成次数不超过二的多项式空间的一个「真子空间」。

examples.en: The three vectors in the question spanned a proper subspace of the given four dimensional space.
examples.zh: 题中的三个向量张成给定四维空间的一个「真子空间」。

collocations: a proper subspace of the domain

words.enDefinition: Interval around a point with the center point itself left out

examples.en: Our proof uses a punctured neighborhood so the value at the center is irrelevant.
examples.zh: 我们的证明采用「去心邻域」，因此中心点处的值无关紧要。

examples.en: The denominator stays nonzero throughout a sufficiently small punctured neighborhood of the target point.
examples.zh: 在目标点足够小的「去心邻域」内，分母始终非零。

words.enDefinition: expressing a matrix as a product of a factor with orthonormal columns and an upper triangular or trapezoidal factor

examples.en: The QR factorization separated the matrix into an orthonormal-column factor and a triangular factor in our example.
examples.zh: 示例中的「QR 分解」把矩阵分成具有标准正交列的因子和一个三角因子。

examples.en: We used QR factorization to solve the least-squares problem without explicitly forming the normal equations.
examples.zh: 我们用「QR 分解」求解最小二乘问题，无需明确列出正规方程。

collocations: solve a system using a QR factorization
verify the factors in a QR factorization

words.enDefinition: a homogeneous polynomial of degree two in real vector coordinates, which can be expressed using a symmetric matrix

examples.en: The quadratic form gave different values when we entered vectors of the same length pointing in different directions.
examples.zh: 将长度相同但方向不同的向量代入后，「二次型」给出了不同值。

examples.en: We rewrote the quadratic form using diagonal coordinates so its cross terms disappeared in the example.
examples.zh: 我们将「二次型」用对角化后的坐标改写，示例中的交叉项随之消失。

collocations: evaluate a quadratic form at a vector

words.enDefinition: a Taylor polynomial retaining terms through the second derivative at the centre

examples.en: The quadratic Taylor polynomial curved near the centre while the first-order approximation had a constant slope.
examples.zh: 「二次泰勒多项式」在中心附近呈曲线形，而一阶近似的斜率恒定。

examples.en: We used a quadratic Taylor polynomial to include the effect of the function's second derivative in our estimate.
examples.zh: 我们用「二次泰勒多项式」，让估计纳入函数二阶导数的影响。

collocations: compare a quadratic Taylor polynomial with the tangent approximation

words.enDefinition: A surface in three-dimensional space described by an equation of degree two in its coordinates.

examples.en: The instructor classified the quadric surface by comparing the signs of the squared coordinate terms.
examples.zh: 老师通过比较各坐标平方项的符号，对「二次曲面」进行分类。

examples.en: We sketched the quadric surface after finding its intersections with several horizontal planes at different heights.
examples.zh: 求出与几个不同高度水平面的交线后，我们画出了「二次曲面」的草图。

words.enDefinition: Function assigning a distribution cutoff to each specified cumulative probability level

examples.en: We evaluated the quantile function at one half to find the model's median.
examples.zh: 我们把二分之一代入「分位数函数」，求出了模型的中位数。

examples.en: The quantile function converts the chosen probability level into a cutoff on the original scale.
examples.zh: 「分位数函数」把所选的概率水平转换为原量表上的界值。

collocations: invert the cumulative distribution to obtain a quantile function

words.enDefinition: Rule dividing existing limits when the denominator's limit is nonzero

examples.en: We used the quotient law for limits after verifying that the denominator approached a nonzero number.
examples.zh: 确认分母趋近一个非零数后，我们用了「极限的商法则」。

examples.en: The quotient law for limits cannot justify dividing by zero in this example calculation.
examples.zh: 在这道计算示例中，「极限的商法则」不能作为除以零的依据。

collocations: apply the quotient law for limits
use the quotient law for limits
conditions for the quotient law for limits

words.enDefinition: Rule dividing the difference of two derivative products by the denominator squared

examples.en: We used the quotient rule for derivatives only where the denominator was different from zero.
examples.zh: 我们只在分母不等于零的地方使用「商的求导法则」。

examples.en: The quotient rule for derivatives subtracts the numerator times the denominator's derivative in the result's numerator.
examples.zh: 使用「商的求导法则」时，结果的分子中要减去原分子乘以原分母的导数。

collocations: apply the quotient rule for derivatives
prove the quotient rule for derivatives
use the quotient rule for derivatives

words.enDefinition: the distance from the centre inside which a power series converges absolutely and outside which it diverges

examples.en: The radius of convergence was three, so we checked the two points three units from the centre.
examples.zh: 「收敛半径」为三，因此我们另外检查了距中心三个单位的两点。

examples.en: We used the ratio test to find the radius of convergence before testing either endpoint separately.
examples.zh: 我们先用比值判别法求「收敛半径」，再分别检查两个端点。

collocations: calculate the radius of convergence using the ratio test

words.enDefinition: Repeatable procedure whose particular outcome is uncertain before it is performed

examples.en: The random experiment consists of drawing one numbered tile from a thoroughly mixed bag.
examples.zh: 这个「随机试验」是从充分混合的袋子中抽出一块编号牌。

examples.en: We described each possible result before carrying out the random experiment in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂进行「随机试验」前，先描述了每一种可能的结果。

words.enDefinition: Numerical function assigning a value to each possible outcome of an experiment

examples.en: The random variable counts how many heads appear when we toss three coins.
examples.zh: 「随机变量」记录抛三枚硬币时出现正面的次数。

examples.en: We defined a random variable that assigns a number to each colored tile.
examples.zh: 我们定义了一个「随机变量」，给每块彩色牌对应一个数值。

words.enDefinition: A test that uses the relative ordering of observations to form its statistic.

examples.en: The rank-based test compares the positions of readings after the two classroom samples are combined.
examples.zh: 「基于秩的检验」在合并两组课堂样本后比较各读数的排序位置。

examples.en: We used a rank-based test because the exercise asks us to compare ordered observations.
examples.zh: 练习要求比较排过序的观测值，因此我们使用「基于秩的检验」。

words.enDefinition: The condition of a matrix having rank smaller than its maximum possible rank for its size.

examples.en: The example showed rank deficiency because only two pivots appeared in the three-by-three matrix.
examples.zh: 这个三行三列的矩阵只出现两个主元，例题体现了「秩亏」。

examples.en: We traced rank deficiency in the square example to one row being a multiple of another.
examples.zh: 我们查明，方阵例题中的「秩亏」源于有一行是另一行的倍数。

words.enDefinition: For a linear map with finite-dimensional domain, its rank plus its nullity equals the domain dimension.

examples.en: We used the rank-nullity theorem to find the nullity after counting three independent columns.
examples.zh: 我们数出三个线性无关的列，再用「秩—零度定理」求零度。

examples.en: The tutor used the rank-nullity theorem to check that both dimensions added up to the input dimension.
examples.zh: 老师用「秩—零度定理」核查两个维数之和是否等于输入空间的维数。

collocations: verify the rank-nullity theorem for a matrix
use the rank-nullity theorem to find a dimension

words.enDefinition: The dimension of a matrix's column space, equal to the dimension of its row space.

examples.en: We found the rank of a matrix by counting the pivots in its echelon form.
examples.zh: 我们数行阶梯形中的主元个数，求出「矩阵的秩」。

examples.en: The rank of a matrix equals the size of its largest linearly independent set of columns.
examples.zh: 「矩阵的秩」等于最多能选出的线性无关列向量数。

collocations: determine the rank of a matrix
find the rank of a matrix from its pivots
compare the rank of a matrix before and after elimination

words.enDefinition: a matrix approximation using a matrix of rank at most one

examples.en: The rank-one approximation kept only the most prominent pattern in the classroom table of measurements.
examples.zh: 「秩一近似」只保留课堂测量表里最明显的模式。

examples.en: We constructed the rank-one approximation from the largest singular value and its corresponding pair of vectors.
examples.zh: 我们根据最大奇异值和对应的一对向量构造「秩一近似」。

collocations: compare a rank-one approximation with the original matrix
measure the error of a rank-one approximation

words.enDefinition: The total of the ranks assigned to observations in one group of a pooled ranking.

examples.en: The rank sum for the first group includes each of its positions in the combined ordering.
examples.zh: 第一组的「秩和」将该组在合并排序中的所有名次相加。

examples.en: We calculated the rank sum before comparing it with the values expected under the null.
examples.zh: 我们先算出「秩和」，再与原假设下预期的数值比较。

words.expression: rate of change with respect to time
words.lemma: rate of change with respect to time
words.enDefinition: Amount a quantity changes per unit of time, locally or over an interval
acceptedEnVariants: rate of change with respect to time

examples.en: We calculated the rate of change with respect to time for the water level at the marked moment.
examples.zh: 我们计算了水位在标记时刻「随时间的变化率」。

examples.en: The rate of change with respect to time has units of centimeters per second in our example.
examples.zh: 在我们的例子中，「随时间的变化率」的单位是厘米每秒。

collocations: calculate the rate of change with respect to time
interpret a rate of change with respect to time
average rate of change with respect to time

words.enDefinition: a test using the limiting magnitude of ratios of successive terms, giving absolute convergence below one and divergence above one

examples.en: The ratio test simplified the factorials and gave a limit below one in our exercise.
examples.zh: 「比值判别法」化简了阶乘，在我们的练习中给出了小于一的极限。

examples.en: The tutor explained why the ratio test did not settle convergence when its limiting ratio equalled one.
examples.zh: 导师解释了为什么极限比等于一时，「比值判别法」无法判定收敛性。

collocations: calculate the limit for the ratio test
determine when the ratio test is inconclusive

words.enDefinition: an integrand expressible as a ratio of polynomial functions

examples.en: The rational integrand needed polynomial division because its numerator had a higher degree than its denominator.
examples.zh: 这个「有理被积函数」的分子次数高于分母，需要先作多项式除法。

examples.en: Our tutor factored the denominator of the rational integrand before selecting a method to evaluate it.
examples.zh: 导师先分解「有理被积函数」的分母，再选择求积分的方法。

collocations: factor the denominator of a rational integrand

words.enDefinition: Remove a radical from the top of a quotient using algebra

examples.en: We chose to rationalize the numerator because the difference of square roots was difficult to evaluate.
examples.zh: 由于平方根之差难以计算，我们选择了「分子有理化」。

examples.en: To rationalize the numerator, we multiplied the fraction by one written with the conjugate expression.
examples.zh: 为了「分子有理化」，我们把分式乘以用共轭式写成的一。

collocations: rationalize the numerator using its conjugate
rationalize the numerator of the quotient

words.enDefinition: Expected value of a specified power of an uncentered random variable

examples.en: We calculated the second raw moment by taking the expected value of the squared variable.
examples.zh: 我们对变量的平方取期望，求得二阶「原点矩」。

examples.en: The exercise uses a raw moment to derive a formula for the variance.
examples.zh: 习题用一个「原点矩」推导出方差公式。

words.enDefinition: for a nonzero vector, the quadratic expression formed with a Hermitian matrix divided by the vector's squared norm

examples.en: The Rayleigh quotient equalled an eigenvalue when the test vector was its corresponding eigenvector in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，若试探向量是某特征值的特征向量，「瑞利商」就等于该特征值。

examples.en: We compared Rayleigh quotient values for unit vectors before looking for the largest one the matrix could attain.
examples.zh: 我们先比较各单位向量的「瑞利商」，再找该矩阵所能达到的最大值。

words.enDefinition: the variational result that the extrema of the Rayleigh quotient of a Hermitian matrix are its extreme eigenvalues

examples.en: The Rayleigh-Ritz theorem let us identify the largest eigenvalue by maximising the quadratic form on unit vectors.
examples.zh: 「瑞利里茨定理」使我们能通过在单位向量上最大化二次型，确定最大特征值。

examples.en: The tutor used the Rayleigh-Ritz theorem to check the smallest eigenvalue in the symmetric matrix example.
examples.zh: 导师用「瑞利里茨定理」核验对称矩阵示例的最小特征值。

collocations: derive bounds with the Rayleigh-Ritz theorem

words.enDefinition: A vector space in which the scalars are real numbers.

examples.en: We used polynomials with real coefficients as our first example of a real vector space.
examples.zh: 我们用实系数多项式作为「实向量空间」的第一个例子。

examples.en: The instructor described how a real vector space can contain functions with real or complex values.
examples.zh: 老师讲解了「实向量空间」中的函数可以取实数值或复数值。

collocations: a basis for a real vector space
a real vector space of polynomials

words.enDefinition: forming a new series by changing the order of the terms without omitting or repeating any of them

examples.en: The exercise compared one rearrangement of a series with its original order under an absolute convergence assumption.
examples.zh: 练习在绝对收敛的假设下，将一种「级数重排」和原有顺序作了比较。

examples.en: We discussed when a rearrangement of a series could change the sum of a conditionally convergent example.
examples.zh: 我们讨论在条件收敛的示例里，什么情况下「级数重排」能改变其和。

collocations: consider a rearrangement of a series
justify a rearrangement of a series
test whether a rearrangement of a series preserves its sum

words.enDefinition: an equation giving a term of a sequence in terms of one or more earlier terms

examples.en: The recurrence relation gave the next balance by adding the same amount to the previous month's value.
examples.zh: 「递推关系」让下期余额等于上月的值加上同一金额。

examples.en: We needed an initial term as well as the recurrence relation to determine the whole sequence.
examples.zh: 要确定整个数列，除了「递推关系」，我们还需要一个初始项。

collocations: combine a recurrence relation with initial values

words.enDefinition: Row echelon form in which each leading entry is one and the only nonzero entry in its column.

examples.en: We reached reduced row echelon form after making each pivot one and clearing its column.
examples.zh: 我们把各主元变成一，并消掉它所在列的其他非零元素后，得到「简化行阶梯形」。

examples.en: The tutor used reduced row echelon form to read the pivot variables directly from the matrix.
examples.zh: 老师用「简化行阶梯形」直接从矩阵读出主元变量。

collocations: find the reduced row echelon form
write the augmented matrix in reduced row echelon form

words.enDefinition: A parametrized differentiable curve whose velocity vector is nonzero throughout the interval in question.

examples.en: The worksheet identifies a regular curve because its velocity vector never vanishes on the stated interval.
examples.zh: 这道题所给区间内速度向量始终非零，所以练习将它认作「正则曲线」。

examples.en: We checked for a regular curve before dividing its derivative by the magnitude in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们先确认它是「正则曲线」，再把导数向量除以它的模。

words.enDefinition: A level surface of a continuously differentiable function whose gradient is nonzero on that surface.

examples.en: The sphere is a regular level surface because the gradient never vanishes at its points.
examples.zh: 这个球面是「正则等值面」，因为其上各点的梯度都非零。

examples.en: We found the tangent plane to the regular level surface using the gradient at the point.
examples.zh: 我们利用该点的梯度求出「正则等值面」的切平面。

collocations: gradient normal to a regular level surface
tangent plane to a regular level surface

words.enDefinition: The set of test-statistic values for which the procedure rejects the null hypothesis.

examples.en: The rejection region contains both tails in the classroom test with a two-sided alternative.
examples.zh: 课堂检验的备择假设为双侧，因此「拒绝域」包含两侧尾部。

examples.en: We shaded the rejection region before locating the calculated statistic on the reference curve.
examples.zh: 我们先给「拒绝域」加阴影，再确定算出的统计量在参考曲线上的位置。

words.enDefinition: Rates of change of quantities linked by an equation and a common variable

examples.en: The related rates exercise links the height of water to its volume over time.
examples.zh: 「相关变化率」练习把水的高度和体积随时间发生的变化联系起来。

examples.en: We used related rates to connect a changing radius with a changing area.
examples.zh: 我们借助「相关变化率」把变化的半径和变化的面积联系起来。

words.enDefinition: Proportion of observed trials on which the event actually occurred

examples.en: We recorded the relative frequency of an event after ten, fifty, and one hundred repeated trials.
examples.zh: 我们分别在重复试验十次、五十次和一百次后记录了「事件的相对频率」。

examples.en: The relative frequency of an event varied more noticeably across small batches of tosses in class.
examples.zh: 在课堂上，每组抛掷次数较少时，组间的「事件的相对频率」波动更明显。

words.enDefinition: Break that can be repaired by assigning the function its finite limiting value

examples.en: The open circle indicates a removable discontinuity because both sides approach the same value.
examples.zh: 空心圆表示「可去间断」，因为两侧都趋近相同的值。

examples.en: We fixed the removable discontinuity by giving the function the missing value at zero.
examples.zh: 我们为函数补上零处缺失的值，修复了「可去间断」。

words.enDefinition: an eigenvalue occurring as a root of the characteristic polynomial more than once

examples.en: The repeated eigenvalue had only one independent eigenvector in the particular matrix shown in class.
examples.zh: 在课上给出的那个矩阵中，「重特征值」的特征空间只有一个基向量。

examples.en: The tutor used a repeated eigenvalue to show why diagonalizability required checking an eigenspace's dimension.
examples.zh: 导师用「重特征值」说明为什么判断能否对角化时需要检查特征空间的维数。

words.enDefinition: a first-degree polynomial factor that occurs more than once in the factorisation of a polynomial

examples.en: The repeated linear factor required several terms using different powers of that factor in their denominators.
examples.zh: 分母中有「重复线性因式」，因此分解需要以该因式不同次幂为分母的多项。

examples.en: We found a repeated linear factor after comparing the denominator with the square of its suspected factor.
examples.zh: 将分母与疑似因式的平方作比较后，我们找到了一个「重复线性因式」。

collocations: expand terms for a repeated linear factor
decompose a fraction with a repeated linear factor

words.enDefinition: to swap the starting and ending bounds of a definite integral, reversing the sign of its value

examples.en: We had to reverse the integration limits after noticing that the exercise asked for the opposite orientation.
examples.zh: 发现题目要求相反的积分方向后，我们必须「交换积分上下限」。

examples.en: The tutor showed why we needed a minus sign when we chose to reverse the integration limits.
examples.zh: 导师说明为什么选用「交换积分上下限」时，结果前需要加负号。

collocations: reverse the integration limits and change the sign
reverse the integration limits to compare results
choose when to reverse the integration limits

words.enDefinition: having Riemann sums that approach the same finite limit as the largest subinterval width tends to zero

examples.en: The tutor showed that the continuous function was Riemann integrable over the closed interval in the example.
examples.zh: 导师说明了示例中的连续函数在这个闭区间上是「黎曼可积的」。

examples.en: We asked whether a bounded function with one jump could still be Riemann integrable on the interval.
examples.zh: 我们问，只有一处跳跃的有界函数在该区间上是否仍是「黎曼可积的」。

words.enDefinition: a sum of function values at sample points multiplied by the widths of their corresponding subintervals

examples.en: Each rectangle in the Riemann sum contributed its signed height multiplied by the width of the subinterval.
examples.zh: 「黎曼和」中各个矩形的贡献，等于带符号的高乘以子区间宽度。

examples.en: We wrote the Riemann sum before taking a limit as the largest subinterval width approached zero.
examples.zh: 我们先写出「黎曼和」，再让最大子区间宽度趋于零以求极限。

words.enDefinition: a Riemann sum evaluating the function at the right endpoint of each subinterval

examples.en: The right endpoint sum was larger because the function was increasing across all the equally spaced subintervals.
examples.zh: 这个函数在所有等宽子区间上递增，因此「右端点和」较大。

examples.en: We drew rectangles for the right endpoint sum before adding up their signed contributions to the estimate.
examples.zh: 我们先画出「右端点和」对应的矩形，再加总各矩形的带符号贡献。

words.enDefinition: Derivative obtained using only positive input increments at the given point

examples.en: The right-hand derivative describes the slope as we approach the endpoint from inside the domain.
examples.zh: 「右导数」描述从定义域内部趋近端点时的差商极限。

examples.en: The student found a right-hand derivative before comparing the slopes from either side.
examples.zh: 这名学生先求了「右导数」，再比较两侧的斜率。

words.enDefinition: Value approached as inputs larger than the target get closer to it

examples.en: The right-hand limit at the step is five in our example, while the left side approaches two.
examples.zh: 在我们的例子中，阶梯跳变处的「右极限」是五，左侧则趋近二。

examples.en: We traced the branch with larger input values to find the right-hand limit.
examples.zh: 我们追踪输入值较大的一侧分支来求「右极限」。

words.enDefinition: The column vector of constants on the right sides of a linear system.

examples.en: We placed the right-hand side vector after the columns containing coefficients of the unknowns.
examples.zh: 我们把「右端项向量」放在包含未知量系数的各列之后。

examples.en: Our tutor changed the right-hand side vector and asked whether the system still had a solution.
examples.zh: 老师改了「右端项向量」，问方程组是否仍然有解。

words.enDefinition: A matrix that gives the identity when multiplied on the right of the specified matrix.

examples.en: We tested the right inverse by placing it after the original matrix before multiplying.
examples.zh: 我们将「右逆」放到原矩阵之后再相乘，以核查结果。

examples.en: The tutor explained why the matrix with independent rows could have a right inverse.
examples.zh: 老师解释了为什么行向量线性无关的矩阵可以有「右逆」。

words.enDefinition: Forming a product by placing the multiplying factor on the right of a specified matrix.

examples.en: In the worksheet, right multiplication by a permutation matrix rearranged the columns of the original matrix.
examples.zh: 练习表中，用一个置换矩阵进行「右乘」会重新排列原矩阵的各列。

examples.zh: 老师问，对图中这对矩形矩阵进行「右乘」是否有定义。

words.enDefinition: a unit eigenvector of the conjugate transpose of a matrix times that matrix, chosen in a singular value decomposition

examples.en: Applying the original matrix to the right singular vector gave a scaled left singular vector in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，原矩阵作用于「右奇异向量」后，得到按比例缩放的左奇异向量。

examples.en: We used the right singular vector to describe an input direction with an unusually large stretching factor.
examples.zh: 我们用「右奇异向量」描述一个拉伸倍数很大的输入方向。

words.enDefinition: Distribution with a longer tail on its high-value side

examples.en: Our right-skewed distribution has many brief waits and a few much longer ones.
examples.zh: 我们的「右偏分布」中，短等待时间很多，较长的等待时间只有少数。

examples.en: We sketched a right-skewed distribution with its tail extending toward larger values.
examples.zh: 我们画了一个尾部向较大数值延伸的「右偏分布」。

words.enDefinition: With continuity and interior differentiability, matching endpoint values imply an interior stationary point

examples.en: We used Rolle's theorem after checking that the function had equal values at both endpoints.
examples.zh: 确认函数在两个端点的值相等后，我们用了「罗尔定理」。

examples.en: The exercise asks why Rolle's theorem fails to apply when the curve has a corner.
examples.zh: 习题问，为什么图像有折角时不能应用「罗尔定理」。

examples.en: We used root bracketing to show that a zero lay between the two endpoints.

examples.en: The root bracketing step came before we tried to estimate the exact root.
examples.zh: 我们先做了「区间夹逼求根」，再尝试估计零点的具体数值。

words.enDefinition: a test using the limit superior of the nth root of each term's magnitude, with one as the undecided threshold

examples.en: The root test removed a power matching the index in each term of the example series.
examples.zh: 「根值判别法」消去了示例级数各项中与下标相同的幂。

examples.en: We chose the root test because raising the same expression to increasing powers made the comparison convenient.
examples.zh: 我们选择「根值判别法」，因为同一个表达式的指数随项数增大，用它比较方便。

words.enDefinition: A matrix form with zero rows last and successive leading entries farther right in lower nonzero rows.

examples.zh: 我们列出将第一个矩阵变为第二个的步骤，证明它们「行等价」。

examples.zh: 老师用「行等价」解释这两个增广矩阵为什么表示相同的解。

examples.en: We used a row interchange to bring a nonzero entry into the first pivot position.
examples.zh: 我们用「行交换」把一个非零元素移到第一个主元位置。

examples.en: The tutor recorded the row interchange before continuing the computation of the determinant.
examples.zh: 老师记录了「行交换」，然后继续计算行列式。

collocations: track the sign change from a row interchange

words.enDefinition: The dimension of the space spanned by the rows of a matrix.

examples.en: We calculated row rank by finding the number of nonzero rows after echelon reduction.
examples.zh: 我们化为行阶梯形后数非零行的个数，算出「行秩」。

examples.en: The tutor used row rank to describe how many independent constraints remained in the system.
examples.zh: 老师用「行秩」说明方程组剩下多少个线性无关的约束。

collocations: compare row rank with column rank
read row rank from echelon form

words.enDefinition: Using elementary row operations to simplify a matrix, often to echelon or reduced echelon form.

examples.en: The worksheet showed each step of row reduction rather than giving only the final matrix.
examples.zh: 练习表逐步写出「行化简」，没有只给最终矩阵。

examples.en: We recorded the operations used in row reduction so our partner could check the arithmetic.
examples.zh: 我们记下了「行化简」所用的操作，方便同伴核对计算。

collocations: show the steps of row reduction
check an error during row reduction

words.enDefinition: Replacing a row by itself plus a scalar multiple of another row.

examples.en: The row replacement added twice the first row to the second in our worksheet.
examples.zh: 练习表的「行倍加变换」把第一行的两倍加到第二行。

examples.en: We used row replacement to eliminate the coefficient under the pivot in the first column.
examples.zh: 我们用「行倍加变换」消掉第一列主元下方的系数。

collocations: eliminate an entry using row replacement

words.enDefinition: The set of all linear combinations of a matrix's rows.

examples.en: We used the nonzero rows of the echelon form as a basis for the row space.
examples.zh: 我们用行阶梯形的非零行作为「行空间」的一组基。

examples.en: The tutor showed that the row space stayed the same through the elementary row operations.
examples.zh: 老师说明，做初等行变换的过程中「行空间」保持不变。

collocations: choose a basis for the row space

words.enDefinition: A vector represented as a matrix with one row.

examples.en: We wrote the recorded scores as a row vector with one position for each quiz.
examples.zh: 我们把记录的分数写成「行向量」，每次小测各占一个位置。

examples.en: The example changed a column of measurements into a row vector before multiplying it.
examples.zh: 例题先把一列测量数据改写为「行向量」，再进行乘法运算。

collocations: multiply a row vector by a matrix

words.enDefinition: A test for nonrandom ordering that compares the number of consecutive runs with its reference behaviour.

examples.en: The runs test counts stretches of the same sign in the worksheet's sequence of differences.
examples.zh: 「游程检验」统计练习纸的差值序列里同号连续出现的段数。

examples.en: We kept the original observation order before applying the runs test to the classroom sequence.
examples.zh: 对课堂序列做「游程检验」前，我们保留了观测的原始顺序。

words.enDefinition: A critical point with both higher and lower function values arbitrarily nearby.

examples.en: The saddle point lies where the surface rises in one direction and falls in another.
examples.zh: 「鞍点」所在处的曲面沿一个方向上升，沿另一个方向下降。

examples.en: We showed that the origin is a saddle point by approaching it along two curves.
examples.zh: 我们沿两条不同曲线趋近原点，证明原点是「鞍点」。

collocations: classify a point as a saddle point

words.enDefinition: The sum of the observed numerical values divided by the number of values in the sample.

examples.en: The sample mean changes when the class draws a different set of observations from the same list.
examples.zh: 全班从同一名单抽出另一组观测时，「样本均值」发生变化。

examples.en: We used the sample mean as one estimate of the centre of the fictional population.
examples.zh: 我们用「样本均值」来估计虚构总体的中心位置。

collocations: sampling distribution of the sample mean

words.enDefinition: a chosen point in a subinterval at which the integrand is evaluated for a Riemann sum

examples.en: Choosing a different sample point changed the height of the rectangle without changing the width of its base.
examples.zh: 选择另一个「取样点」会改变矩形的高，底边宽度保持不变。

examples.en: We selected the right endpoint as the sample point in every subinterval of the first example.
examples.zh: 第一个示例里，我们以每段子区间的右端点作「取样点」。

collocations: evaluate the function at a sample point

words.enDefinition: The fraction of sampled observations with the characteristic of interest.

examples.en: The sample proportion is the number of students who cycle divided by the total number surveyed.
examples.zh: 「样本比例」用骑自行车的学生人数除以受访学生总数得到。

examples.en: We recorded the sample proportion from each simulated draw before examining how much it varied.
examples.zh: 我们记下各次模拟抽取的「样本比例」，再检查它的变动幅度。

collocations: sampling distribution of a sample proportion

words.enDefinition: Set containing all possible outcomes of the random procedure being modeled

examples.en: The sample space for two labeled dice contains ordered pairs of possible face values.
examples.zh: 两枚有标记骰子的「样本空间」由可能点数构成的有序对组成。

examples.en: We changed the sample space when the exercise began recording colors instead of numbers.
examples.zh: 习题改为记录颜色后，我们也调整了「样本空间」。

words.enDefinition: A number calculated from sample observations alone.

examples.en: The sample statistic is calculated from the responses of the students actually drawn for the survey.
examples.zh: 「样本统计量」用实际抽中学生的回答计算得出。

examples.en: We used the median as a sample statistic to describe the survey responses in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用中位数作为「样本统计量」来描述调查回答。

collocations: observed value of a sample statistic

words.enDefinition: A measure of squared spread around the sample mean, commonly using the sample size minus one as divisor.

examples.en: The sample variance is larger for the group whose scores are more spread out in our example.
examples.zh: 示例中，成绩分布更分散的组，其「样本方差」更大。

examples.en: We calculated the sample variance by dividing the squared deviation sum by the sample size minus one.
examples.zh: 我们把离均差平方和除以样本量减一，得到「样本方差」。

words.enDefinition: The distribution of a statistic across all samples that could be drawn using the same design.

examples.en: The sampling distribution shows how the sample mean varies across repeated draws of the same size.
examples.zh: 「抽样分布」显示样本均值如何随同一样本量的反复抽取而变化。

examples.en: We approximated the sampling distribution by repeating the classroom sampling exercise many times on simulated data.
examples.zh: 我们在模拟数据上反复进行课堂抽样练习，以近似得到「抽样分布」。

words.enDefinition: The deviation of a sample estimate from its population value arising because only a sample was observed.

examples.en: The sampling error changes across repeated draws even when the population mean stays fixed.
examples.zh: 即使总体均值保持不变，各次抽取的「抽样误差」也会变化。

examples.en: We illustrated sampling error by comparing each simulated survey estimate with the known population value.
examples.zh: 我们把各次模拟调查的估计值与已知总体值比较，以说明「抽样误差」。

words.enDefinition: For a fixed-size sample, the number selected divided by the number of units in the population or stratum.

examples.en: The sampling fraction is one fifth because the exercise selects twenty of the hundred records.
examples.zh: 练习从一百条记录中抽取二十条，因此「抽样比」为五分之一。

examples.en: We compared the sampling fraction used for the two groups in the fictional school survey.
examples.zh: 我们比较了虚构学校调查中两组所用的「抽样比」。

words.enDefinition: The list or other representation used to identify units available for selection into a sample.

examples.en: The sampling frame lists the households eligible for selection in our fictional district survey.
examples.zh: 「抽样框」列出虚构地区调查中可被抽中的各户家庭。

examples.en: We checked whether the sampling frame omitted households in the newly built part of town.
examples.zh: 我们检查「抽样框」是否漏掉了镇上新建区域的住户。

words.enDefinition: An individual element or group selected at a stage of a sampling design.

examples.en: The sampling unit is a classroom when the first draw selects entire classes in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习第一轮抽取整个班级时，「抽样单位」就是班级。

examples.en: We identified the sampling unit before counting how many selections were made at each stage.
examples.zh: 我们先确定「抽样单位」，再统计各阶段的抽取次数。

words.enDefinition: Drawing repeatedly from a population while returning selected items before subsequent draws

examples.en: With sampling with replacement, the same numbered tile can appear on two consecutive draws.
examples.zh: 采用「放回抽样」时，同一块编号牌可能连续两次被抽到。

examples.en: The class used sampling with replacement to keep the contents of the bag unchanged between draws.
examples.zh: 全班采用「放回抽样」，让袋中物品在两次抽取之间保持不变。

collocations: sampling with replacement from a bag

words.enDefinition: Drawing repeatedly from a population while leaving selected items out of later draws

examples.en: Under sampling without replacement, a tile removed on the first draw cannot appear again.
examples.zh: 采用「不放回抽样」时，第一次抽出并取走的牌不能再次出现。

examples.en: We modeled sampling without replacement to allow the second probability to depend on the first result.
examples.zh: 我们对「不放回抽样」建模，让第二次的概率可以取决于第一次的结果。

collocations: sampling without replacement from a bag

words.enDefinition: A function assigning a scalar value to each point in a region.

examples.en: The scalar field assigns one temperature value to each point inside the modelled room.
examples.zh: 「标量场」为模型房间内部的每个点赋予一个温度值。

examples.en: We drew level curves of the scalar field on a horizontal cross section of the room.
examples.zh: 我们在房间的水平截面上画出了「标量场」的等值线。

words.enDefinition: An integral of a scalar field along a curve with respect to arc length.
acceptedEnVariants: line integral of a scalar field

examples.en: The scalar line integral adds the modelled density along the entire curved strip in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中的「第一类曲线积分」沿整个曲线对模型线密度进行累加。

examples.en: We used a scalar line integral to find the mass of the thin curved wire.
examples.zh: 我们用「第一类曲线积分」求出弯曲细线的质量。

collocations: scalar line integral along a curve

words.enDefinition: Multiplying every entry of a matrix by the same scalar.

examples.en: The scalar multiplication of a matrix by three tripled every entry in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂例题中，以三为标量做「矩阵的数乘」，每个元素都变为原来的三倍。

examples.en: Our tutor illustrated scalar multiplication of a matrix before combining it with another matrix of matching size.
examples.zh: 老师先演示了「矩阵的数乘」，再将结果与另一个同样大小的矩阵相加。

collocations: perform scalar multiplication of a matrix
check scalar multiplication of a matrix entry by entry
use scalar multiplication of a matrix to rescale entries

words.enDefinition: An integral of a scalar function over a surface with respect to surface area.
acceptedEnVariants: surface integral of a scalar field

examples.en: The scalar surface integral gives the mass of the thin shell when its surface density varies.
examples.zh: 薄壳的面密度随位置变化时，可以用「第一类曲面积分」求其质量。

examples.en: We used a scalar surface integral of one to find the total surface area in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用被积函数恒为一的「第一类曲面积分」算出总表面积。

collocations: scalar surface integral over a patch

words.enDefinition: The scalar formed by taking the dot product of one vector with the cross product of two others.

examples.en: The absolute value of the scalar triple product gives the volume of the box in our diagram.
examples.zh: 「标量三重积」的绝对值给出图中平行六面体的体积。

examples.en: The scalar triple product is zero when the three vectors extend from a point within one plane.
examples.zh: 三个向量从同一点出发并位于同一平面时，「标量三重积」为零。

collocations: sign of the scalar triple product

words.enDefinition: To multiply every entry of a row by the same nonzero scalar in an elementary row operation.

examples.en: We chose to scale a row by one half to make its leading entry equal one.
examples.zh: 我们按法则「给一行乘以非零数」，用二分之一让首个非零元素变成一。

examples.en: The tutor asked which factor would scale a row without changing the system's solution set.
examples.zh: 老师问，「给一行乘以非零数」时应取哪个数，才能保持方程组的解集不变。

collocations: scale a row by a nonzero number
scale a row to obtain a leading one
scale a row of the augmented matrix

words.enDefinition: Positive parameter stretching or compressing a distribution along its measurement scale

examples.en: Increasing the scale parameter made the probability curve broader in our classroom example.
examples.zh: 在课堂例子中，增加「尺度参数」使概率曲线变得更宽。

examples.en: We held the scale parameter fixed while moving the center of the distribution.
examples.zh: 我们在移动分布中心时保持「尺度参数」不变。

words.enDefinition: writing a complex square matrix as a unitary conjugate of an upper triangular matrix

examples.en: The Schur decomposition put the eigenvalues on the diagonal of a triangular factor in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂示例的「舒尔分解」使各特征值位于三角因子的对角线上。

examples.en: We used Schur decomposition to study a matrix that admitted no unitary diagonalization.
examples.zh: 我们用「舒尔分解」研究一个无法通过酉变换对角化的矩阵。

collocations: read eigenvalues from a Schur decomposition

words.enDefinition: Line passing through two distinct points on the graph being studied

examples.en: The slope of the secant line gives the average change between the two inputs.
examples.zh: 「割线」的斜率给出了两个输入值之间的平均变化率。

examples.en: As the points moved together, the secant line approached the tangent in our drawing.
examples.zh: 随着两点靠拢，我们图中的「割线」逐渐趋近切线。

words.enDefinition: Derivative obtained by differentiating a function's first derivative one more time

examples.en: We used the second derivative to determine where the curve was concave upward.
examples.zh: 我们用「二阶导数」判断图像在哪里向上弯曲。

examples.en: The second derivative is constant in our example because the first derivative is linear.
examples.zh: 在我们的例子中，一阶导数是线性函数，所以「二阶导数」是常数。

words.enDefinition: Criterion using second derivative sign at a stationary point to classify it

examples.en: The second derivative test identified a local maximum because the second derivative was negative there.
examples.zh: 由于该点的二阶导数为负，「二阶导数判别法」判定了一个局部最大值。

examples.en: We learned that the second derivative test is inconclusive when the second derivative equals zero.
examples.zh: 我们学到，二阶导数为零时，「二阶导数判别法」不能给出结论。

collocations: classify a point using the second derivative test

words.enDefinition: A partial derivative taken by differentiating an existing first-order partial derivative once more.

examples.en: The second-order partial derivative measures how one component of the gradient changes in our exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中的「二阶偏导数」衡量梯度的一个分量如何变化。

examples.en: We calculated the second-order partial derivative by differentiating with respect to the same variable again.
examples.zh: 我们对同一个变量再次求导，算出这个「二阶偏导数」。

collocations: second-order partial derivative at a point

words.enDefinition: the sequence formed by summing successively longer initial segments of the terms of a series

examples.en: The sequence of partial sums had a finite limit even though the original series had infinitely many terms.
examples.zh: 虽然原级数有无穷多项，但「部分和数列」存在有限极限。

examples.en: We plotted the sequence of partial sums before deciding whether the sums appeared to approach one value.
examples.zh: 我们先画出「部分和数列」，再看这些和是否趋于同一个值。

collocations: form a sequence of partial sums
find the limit of the sequence of partial sums
compare the sequence of partial sums with the terms

words.enDefinition: an individual value in a sequence associated with a particular index

examples.en: The third sequence term was negative because the rule alternated signs as the index increased.
examples.zh: 随着下标增加，规则让正负号交替，所以第三个「数列的项」为负。

examples.en: We labelled each sequence term with its index before plotting the first six points in class.
examples.zh: 我们先为各个「数列的项」标注下标，再在课堂上描出前六个点。

words.enDefinition: retaining only a finite initial part of a series to obtain an approximation

examples.en: The series truncation kept the first three terms, and the worksheet estimated the size of the omitted tail.
examples.zh: 「级数截断」保留前三项，练习表估计了被省略尾部的大小。

examples.en: We kept more terms in the series truncation because the shorter estimate was inaccurate near the endpoint.
examples.zh: 由于较短的近似式在端点附近不够准确，我们在「级数截断」时保留了更多项。

collocations: bound the error after series truncation

words.enDefinition: Parameter altering a distribution's profile beyond shifting or uniformly rescaling it

examples.en: A different shape parameter gave the curve a different degree of asymmetry.
examples.zh: 另一个「形状参数」值使曲线的不对称程度发生变化。

examples.en: We changed the shape parameter while leaving the scale fixed in the model.
examples.zh: 我们改变「形状参数」，同时在模型中保持尺度固定。

collocations: shape parameter of a gamma distribution

words.enDefinition: Table displaying where an expression is positive, negative, or zero

examples.en: We drew a sign chart for the derivative before classifying the critical numbers.
examples.zh: 我们先列出了导数的「符号表」，再判断各临界数对应的点属于哪一类。

examples.en: The sign chart shows a change from positive to negative at the rightmost zero.
examples.zh: 「符号表」显示，在最右侧的零点，导数由正变负。

collocations: mark zeros on a sign chart

words.enDefinition: A test based on counts of positive and negative deviations or paired differences, excluding zeros.

examples.en: The sign test counts how often the second classroom reading exceeds the first for each device.
examples.zh: 「符号检验」统计各台设备第二次课堂读数超过第一次的次数。

examples.en: We excluded zero differences before applying the sign test in the paired measurement exercise.
examples.zh: 在配对测量练习中，我们先去掉零差值，再应用「符号检验」。

words.enDefinition: area counted positively above a reference axis and negatively below it in an integration problem

examples.en: The signed area was zero because the region above the axis matched the region below it.
examples.zh: 「带符号的面积」为零，因为坐标轴上、下两部分的区域面积相同。

examples.en: We drew the positive and negative regions separately before computing the signed area in the example.
examples.zh: 计算示例的「带符号的面积」前，我们分别画出了正、负区域。

collocations: cancel regions in the signed area
compare signed area with geometric area

words.enDefinition: The chosen maximum probability of rejecting the null hypothesis when it is true under the test model.

examples.en: The significance level was specified before any classroom data were examined for differences between the groups.
examples.zh: 我们在查找课堂数据里的组间差异之前，就定好了「显著性水平」。

examples.en: We compared the reported probability with the significance level chosen for the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们将报告的概率与练习选定的「显著性水平」比较。

words.enDefinition: square matrices representing the same linear map under different bases, related by an invertible conjugation

examples.en: The two similar matrices had different entries but represented the same map in our two chosen bases.
examples.zh: 这两个「相似矩阵」的各项不同，但在所选的两组基下表示同一个映射。

examples.en: We found an invertible change of basis proving that the examples were similar matrices over the real numbers.
examples.zh: 我们找到了一个可逆换基矩阵，证明这两个示例在实数范围内是「相似矩阵」。

collocations: show that two matrices are similar
compare the traces of similar matrices

words.enDefinition: conjugating a square matrix by an invertible matrix to express the same linear map in another basis

examples.en: The similarity transformation changed the entries of the matrix while preserving its eigenvalues in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中的「相似变换」改变了矩阵各项的取值，仍保留特征值。

examples.en: We checked which side received the inverse in the formula for the similarity transformation before multiplying.
examples.zh: 相乘前，我们核查「相似变换」公式中逆矩阵放在哪一侧。

collocations: verify an invariant under a similarity transformation

words.enDefinition: A loop that meets itself only where its starting and ending points coincide.

examples.en: The simple closed curve surrounds the shaded region and has no self-intersections in the diagram.
examples.zh: 「简单闭曲线」围住图中的阴影区域，且不会自相交。

examples.en: We chose a simple closed curve as the boundary of the region in the example.
examples.zh: 我们选一条「简单闭曲线」作为示例区域的边界。

collocations: region bounded by a simple closed curve
orientation of a simple closed curve

words.enDefinition: an eigenvalue with algebraic multiplicity one

examples.en: The simple eigenvalue appeared as a factor that occurred only once in the characteristic polynomial.
examples.zh: 「单特征值」对应特征多项式中只出现一次的因式。

examples.en: We identified a simple eigenvalue before examining the pair of repeated roots in the example.
examples.zh: 我们先识别一个「单特征值」，再查看示例中出现两次的根。

collocations: find an eigenvector for a simple eigenvalue

words.enDefinition: Event containing exactly one outcome from the chosen sample space

examples.en: In this model, rolling exactly two is a simple event with one possible outcome.
examples.zh: 在这个模型中，恰好掷出两点是一个「简单事件」，只包含一个可能结果。

examples.en: We used braces to represent the simple event containing the single possible outcome.
examples.zh: 我们用花括号表示只包含一个可能结果的「简单事件」。

words.enDefinition: A fixed-size sample for which all possible subsets of that size are equally likely under sampling without replacement.

examples.en: The simple random sample contains four records drawn from the same complete list in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中的「简单随机样本」包含从同一份完整名单抽出的四条记录。

examples.en: We used a simple random sample to illustrate why different draws can give different means.
examples.zh: 我们用「简单随机样本」说明不同的抽取结果为何可能产生不同均值。

words.enDefinition: A path-connected region in which every closed loop can be continuously contracted to a point inside the region.

examples.en: The disk is a simply connected region because every loop in it can shrink to a point.
examples.zh: 圆盘是「单连通区域」，因为其中每条闭合曲线都可以缩成一点。

examples.en: The tutor asked whether removing the centre still leaves a simply connected region in the plane.
examples.zh: 老师问，去掉中心后，平面内剩下的区域是否仍为「单连通区域」。

collocations: prove a region is simply connected
vector field on a simply connected region

words.enDefinition: a numerical rule using quadratic interpolation over pairs of consecutive equally spaced subintervals to estimate a definite integral

examples.en: We used Simpson's rule after dividing the worksheet's interval into an even number of equal subintervals.
examples.zh: 我们把练习表的区间等分成偶数个子区间后，使用了「辛普森求积公式」。

examples.en: The tutor compared Simpson's rule with the trapezoidal estimate for a curve that bent upward throughout.
examples.zh: 对于一条始终向上弯的曲线，导师比较了「辛普森求积公式」与梯形估计。

collocations: estimate an integral with Simpson's rule
check the spacing for Simpson's rule

words.enDefinition: A set of intervals designed to cover all corresponding parameters together at a stated overall confidence level.

examples.en: The simultaneous confidence intervals are wider here because they are designed to cover all pairwise differences together.
examples.zh: 这里的「同时置信区间」更宽，因为其设计是同时覆盖全部两两差异。

examples.en: We reported simultaneous confidence intervals when presenting the full set of classroom comparisons on one chart.
examples.zh: 我们用一张图展示整组课堂比较时，报告了「同时置信区间」。

words.enDefinition: Study of limits, derivatives, and integrals for functions of one variable

examples.en: Our single-variable calculus course begins with the idea of approaching a point along a curve.
examples.zh: 我们的「一元微积分」课从沿曲线趋近某点的概念讲起。

examples.en: We used single-variable calculus to find when the height of the ball stopped increasing.
examples.zh: 我们用「一元微积分」求球的高度在什么时候停止增加。

words.enDefinition: A square matrix that does not have an inverse.

examples.en: The determinant was zero, so we identified the coefficient matrix on the worksheet as a singular matrix.
examples.zh: 行列式为零，因此我们判断习题中的系数矩阵是「奇异矩阵」。

examples.en: The tutor pointed out that the singular matrix had two identical columns in this example.
examples.zh: 老师指出，此例中的「奇异矩阵」有两列完全相同。

words.enDefinition: a factorization of a matrix into orthonormal left and right directions and a diagonal array of nonnegative scaling values

examples.en: The singular value decomposition showed how the rectangular matrix stretched or collapsed different input directions in the example.
examples.zh: 「奇异值分解」说明示例中的矩形矩阵如何拉伸或压缩不同输入方向。

examples.zh: 第二个奇异值之后的「奇异值间隙」有助于解释为什么秩二近似在课堂示例中效果好。

words.enDefinition: Lines in three-dimensional space that neither intersect nor lie in a common plane.

examples.zh: 图中的两条直轨不平行也不相交，因此属于「异面直线」。

examples.zh: 我们用盒子的两条棱说明不相交的「异面直线」。

words.enDefinition: a real square matrix whose transpose equals its negative

examples.en: The skew-symmetric matrix had zeros along the diagonal and opposite entries in positions across it.
examples.zh: 这个「反对称矩阵」的对角项为零，关于对角线对称的项互为相反数。

examples.en: We verified the skew-symmetric matrix by transposing it and comparing the result with its negative.
examples.zh: 我们转置并与其相反矩阵比较，检验这个「反对称矩阵」。

collocations: test whether a matrix is skew-symmetric

examples.en: Polynomial division revealed a slant asymptote because the remaining fraction tends to zero.
examples.zh: 由于剩余分式趋于零，多项式除法给出了「斜渐近线」。

examples.en: We drew the slant asymptote to show the behavior of the far right branch.
examples.zh: 我们画出「斜渐近线」，展示图像最右侧分支的走势。

collocations: identify a slant asymptote by division

words.enDefinition: Rate of vertical change per horizontal unit along a tangent line

examples.en: We found the slope of the tangent line by evaluating the derivative at the given input.
examples.zh: 我们将给定的输入值代入导数，求得「切线斜率」。

examples.en: The slope of the tangent line is negative at the marked point on our graph.
examples.zh: 我们图中标记点处的「切线斜率」为负。

collocations: find the slope of the tangent line

words.enDefinition: a three-dimensional object formed by rotating a plane region about a line

examples.en: Rotating the shaded area around the horizontal axis produced the solid of revolution shown in our sketch.
examples.zh: 将阴影区域绕横轴旋转，就得到草图上的「旋转体」。

examples.zh: 我们在决定用哪条体积公式前，先画出「旋转体」的一个截面。

collocations: find the volume of a solid of revolution

words.enDefinition: The set of all values or vectors satisfying the stated equations.

examples.en: We wrote the solution set using a parameter because one variable could take any real value.
examples.zh: 一个变量可以取任意实数，因此我们用参数表示「解集」。

examples.en: The tutor looked for another solution set after changing one constant in the original equations.
examples.zh: 老师改变了原方程组中的一个常数，再求新的「解集」。

collocations: write a solution set in parametric form

words.enDefinition: An ordered vector of values that satisfies all the equations in a system.

examples.en: We checked the solution vector by substituting its entries into every equation from the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们把向量中的各个值代入练习表的每个方程，核查「解向量」。

examples.en: The last entry of the solution vector represented the number of pieces needed from the third group.
examples.zh: 「解向量」的最后一个元素表示需要第三组提供多少个零件。

collocations: substitute a solution vector into the system

words.enDefinition: A curve in three-dimensional space, often represented by three functions of a single parameter.

examples.en: The space curve winds upward as the moving point circles the vertical axis in the animation.
examples.zh: 动画中，运动点绕竖直轴转动，「空间曲线」随之盘旋上升。

examples.en: We sketched the space curve by plotting several points from all three coordinate functions.
examples.zh: 我们用三个坐标函数算出几个点，画出「空间曲线」的草图。

words.enDefinition: A set of vectors whose linear combinations give every vector in the specified space.

examples.en: We removed the repeated vector and still had a spanning set for the same subspace.
examples.zh: 去掉重复向量后，剩下的仍是同一个子空间的「生成集」。

examples.en: The instructor asked for a spanning set of polynomials that included both constant and quadratic terms.
examples.zh: 老师要求写出一个由多项式组成的「生成集」，其中同时包含常数项和二次项。

words.enDefinition: The ordinary correlation computed on the ranks of paired values, measuring monotonic association.

examples.en: Spearman rank correlation is positive when longer study times generally correspond to higher test scores.
examples.zh: 较长的学习时间通常对应较高的测试分数时，「斯皮尔曼秩相关」为正。

examples.en: We calculated Spearman rank correlation to assess whether the two variables tended to increase together.
examples.zh: 我们计算「斯皮尔曼秩相关」，评估两个变量是否倾向于一起增大。

words.enDefinition: writing a normal operator as a sum of its eigenvalues multiplied by the projections onto the corresponding eigenspaces

examples.en: The spectral decomposition expressed the matrix as two scalar-weighted projections onto its eigenspaces in our exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中的「谱分解」把矩阵表示为两个投向相应特征空间的投影，各自乘以标量。

examples.en: We used spectral decomposition to compute powers by raising the scalar weights while retaining the same projections.
examples.zh: 我们用「谱分解」来求矩阵幂，只需将标量权重分别取幂，保持原投影算子。

collocations: compute a power from the spectral decomposition

examples.en: The spectral gap was small, so the tutor compared the two largest eigenvalues more carefully before interpreting them.
examples.zh: 「谱间隙」很小，因此导师在解读前更仔细地比较了两个最大的特征值。

examples.zh: 我们比较包含正、负特征值的示例时，报告了「谱间隙」所用的约定。

words.enDefinition: the maximum Euclidean norm of a matrix's output over all input vectors of Euclidean norm one

examples.en: The spectral norm measured the maximum stretching of any unit vector by the rectangular matrix in class.
examples.zh: 「谱范数」衡量课堂中的矩形矩阵对任意单位向量可产生的最大拉伸倍数。

examples.zh: 我们用最大奇异值核查练习中对「谱范数」的计算。

collocations: bound an error in the spectral norm

examples.zh: 由于练习中的矩阵为实对称矩阵，导师运用「谱定理」得到一组实标准正交的特征向量基。

examples.en: We used the spectral theorem after checking that the complex matrix commuted with its conjugate transpose.

words.enDefinition: Three coordinates giving distance from the origin and two angles that specify direction in space.

examples.zh: 我们为「统计容忍区间」同时记录了目标覆盖比例和置信水平。

examples.zh: 全班用「分层随机抽样」纳入虚构学校各年级的观测。
