words.enDefinition: Smallest closed set containing a variable's value with probability one

examples.en: We read the support of a distribution from the values with positive probabilities in the discrete table.
examples.zh: 我们从离散分布表中概率为正的取值读出了「分布的支撑集」。

examples.en: The support of a distribution consists of the nonnegative integers in the example we discussed.
examples.zh: 在我们讨论的例子里，「分布的支撑集」由非负整数组成。

collocations: find the support of a distribution
specify the support of a distribution
describe the support of a distribution

words.enDefinition: The area factor for integrating over a surface, including the local scaling from its parametrization.

examples.en: The surface area element accounts for stretching when a small rectangle maps onto the curved patch.
examples.zh: 小矩形被映射到曲面片时，「曲面面积微元」会计入面积缩放。

examples.en: We found the surface area element from the length of a cross product in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用一个叉积的模求出「曲面面积微元」。

collocations: surface area element of a parametrized surface

words.enDefinition: the area of the surface swept out when a curve rotates around an axis

examples.en: We found the surface area of revolution by integrating the circumference traced by each arc element.
examples.zh: 我们对各弧长微元扫出的圆的周长积分，得到「旋转曲面面积」。

examples.en: The surface area of revolution changed when the same curve was rotated around a different axis.
examples.zh: 同一条曲线绕另一个轴旋转时，「旋转曲面面积」改变了。

collocations: compute a surface area of revolution
derive the formula for surface area of revolution
estimate a surface area of revolution

words.enDefinition: A linear map whose outputs cover the entire codomain.

examples.en: Our example gave a surjective linear map because each vector in the codomain had at least one preimage.
examples.zh: 在我们的例子中，陪域中每个向量至少有一个原像，因此该映射是「满射线性映射」。

examples.en: The tutor asked whether dropping the last coordinate defines a surjective linear map onto the remaining coordinate space.
examples.zh: 老师问，去掉最后一个坐标是否定义了一个到其余坐标构成的空间的「满射线性映射」。

collocations: verify that a map is a surjective linear map
the codomain of a surjective linear map

words.enDefinition: the test that a real symmetric or complex Hermitian matrix is positive definite exactly when all its leading principal minors are positive

examples.en: We used Sylvester's criterion to test the symmetric matrix without first solving for all its eigenvalues.
examples.zh: 我们用「西尔维斯特判别准则」检验该对称矩阵，不必先求所有特征值。

examples.en: The tutor checked the symmetry hypothesis before applying Sylvester's criterion to the three by three example.
examples.zh: 导师应用「西尔维斯特判别准则」检验这个三阶示例之前，先核查了对称性假设。

collocations: check the hypotheses of Sylvester's criterion
use Sylvester's criterion for positive definiteness

words.enDefinition: the theorem that an invertible real congruence preserves the counts of positive, negative and zero eigenvalues of a symmetric matrix

examples.en: The tutor used Sylvester's law of inertia to explain why changing coordinates could not remove a negative direction.
examples.zh: 导师用「西尔维斯特惯性定律」说明，为什么换坐标无法消除使二次型为负的方向。

examples.en: We used Sylvester's law of inertia to test whether two diagonal matrices represented the same quadratic form.
examples.zh: 我们用「西尔维斯特惯性定律」比较两个对角形式，检查它们是否可能表示同一个二次型。

collocations: classify a form using Sylvester's law of inertia

words.enDefinition: Probability distribution that remains unchanged when reflected around its central point

examples.en: The symmetric distribution gives the same probability to equally wide ranges on opposite sides.
examples.zh: 在中心两侧相同位置的等宽区间内，「对称分布」赋予的概率相同。

examples.en: We drew a symmetric distribution by reflecting the left half across its vertical center line.
examples.zh: 我们将左半部分沿其中心竖线作镜像，画出了一个「对称分布」。

words.enDefinition: Equations that equate coordinate differences divided by nonzero direction components, with any remaining coordinates kept constant.

examples.en: The symmetric equations of a line include a separate constant coordinate when one direction component vanishes.
examples.zh: 一个方向分量为零时，「直线的对称方程」另列一个恒定坐标。

examples.en: We derived the symmetric equations of a line by eliminating its parameter from the coordinate formulas.
examples.zh: 我们从各坐标公式中消去参数，导出「直线的对称方程」。

collocations: write symmetric equations of a line
derive symmetric equations of a line
use symmetric equations of a line

words.enDefinition: A square matrix equal to its own transpose.

examples.en: We compared the entries across the main diagonal before calling the example a symmetric matrix.
examples.zh: 把例题中的矩阵称为「对称矩阵」之前，我们先比较了主对角线两侧成对的元素。

examples.en: Our tutor changed one entry and asked what else must change to preserve the symmetric matrix.
examples.zh: 老师改动一个元素后问，还要改什么才能保持它是「对称矩阵」。

collocations: check whether a matrix is symmetric
compare paired entries of a symmetric matrix

words.enDefinition: Several linear equations considered together for the same unknowns.

examples.en: We wrote a system of linear equations to represent the constraints on three material quantities.
examples.zh: 我们写了一个「线性方程组」，表示对三种材料数量的约束。

examples.en: The tutor checked each value against the entire system of linear equations in our example.
examples.zh: 老师将各个数值代入例题的整个「线性方程组」进行核对。

collocations: write a system of linear equations
solve a system of linear equations
represent a system of linear equations with a matrix

words.enDefinition: A design that takes every specified number of units from an ordered list after a random start.

examples.en: Systematic sampling chooses every tenth record after a random starting point in our classroom example.
examples.zh: 在课堂示例中，「系统抽样」从随机起点开始，每十条抽取一条记录。

examples.en: We checked the ordering of the list before applying systematic sampling to the fictional records.
examples.zh: 我们先核对名单的排列顺序，再对虚构记录做「系统抽样」。

words.enDefinition: organising repeated integration by parts in paired columns of successive derivatives and antiderivatives with appropriate signs
acceptedEnVariants: tabular method of integration by parts

examples.en: The tutor used tabular integration by parts to arrange the repeated derivatives and integrals in two columns.
examples.zh: 导师用「表格分部积分法」将逐次求导和积分的结果排列成两列。

examples.en: We checked the alternating signs in tabular integration by parts before combining the products on the worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们先核对「表格分部积分法」中交替出现的正负号，再合并练习表上的各乘积。

collocations: choose factors for tabular integration by parts
verify signs in tabular integration by parts

words.enDefinition: the remaining terms after a specified initial segment of a series, or their sum when defined

examples.en: We compared the tail of a series with a geometric bound after discarding the initial terms in class.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂上去掉开头几项，将「级数的尾部」与一个等比上界作比较。

examples.en: The tutor showed why the tail of a series became small once enough terms had been added.
examples.zh: 导师说明为什么加够项以后，「级数的尾部」之和会变小。

collocations: bound the tail of a series
estimate the tail of a series
compare the tail of a series with a geometric series

words.enDefinition: Probability lying beyond a specified cutoff on one side of a distribution

examples.en: We found the tail probability above ten by subtracting the cumulative probability from one.
examples.zh: 我们用一减去累积概率，求得大于十的「尾部概率」。

examples.en: The graph shades the tail probability to the left of the selected cutoff.
examples.zh: 这张图用阴影表示选定界值左侧的「尾部概率」。

words.enDefinition: Line through a curve point with the curve's local direction there

examples.en: The slope of the tangent line matches the rate at which the graph rises locally.
examples.zh: 「切线」的斜率与图像在该点附近的上升速率相符。

examples.en: We drew the tangent line through the point where the derivative was known.
examples.zh: 我们在已知导数的点处画出了「切线」。

words.enDefinition: The plane that gives a first-order geometric approximation to a smooth surface at a point.

examples.en: The tangent plane touches the surface at the marked point and follows its local tilt.
examples.zh: 「切平面」在标记点与曲面相切，并体现该处的倾斜。

examples.en: We used two first partial derivatives to write the tangent plane for the height function.
examples.zh: 我们用两个一阶偏导数写出高度函数图形的「切平面」。

words.enDefinition: The full group that a statistical study aims to describe or draw conclusions about.

examples.en: The target population includes every student enrolled in the fictional university during the autumn term.
examples.zh: 「目标总体」包括这所虚构大学秋季学期注册的所有学生。

examples.en: We defined the target population before choosing the records available for the classroom survey.
examples.zh: 我们先界定「目标总体」，再挑选课堂调查能使用的记录。

words.enDefinition: an nth derivative evaluated at the expansion centre and divided by n factorial

examples.en: We obtained the Taylor coefficient of degree four by dividing the fourth derivative at zero by four factorial.
examples.zh: 我们将零处的四阶导数除以四的阶乘，得到四次项的「泰勒系数」。

examples.en: The second Taylor coefficient changed when we moved the expansion point to the right in the function's domain.
examples.zh: 把展开点在函数定义域内向右移动后，第二个「泰勒系数」变了。

collocations: derive a Taylor coefficient from a derivative
compare Taylor coefficients at two centres

words.enDefinition: a polynomial built from derivatives at a point to match a function's value and derivatives through a specified order

examples.en: The Taylor polynomial matched the function and its first two derivatives at the centre in our worksheet.
examples.zh: 我们的练习表上，「泰勒多项式」与函数及其前两阶导数在中心处相同。

examples.en: We compared the Taylor polynomial with the function graph near the point where the derivatives were taken.
examples.zh: 我们在取导数的点附近，将「泰勒多项式」与原函数图像作了比较。

collocations: approximate a function with a Taylor polynomial

words.enDefinition: the difference between the original function and its Taylor polynomial at the point being evaluated
acceptedEnVariants: remainder term of a Taylor polynomial

examples.en: We estimated the Taylor remainder to find a bound on the error in the quadratic approximation.
examples.zh: 我们估计「泰勒余项」，给二次近似的误差定出上界。

examples.en: The Taylor remainder was zero because the original function was already a polynomial of the required degree.
examples.zh: 因为原函数本来就是所要求次数的多项式，所以「泰勒余项」为零。

collocations: control the size of the Taylor remainder

words.enDefinition: a theorem expressing a sufficiently differentiable function locally by a Taylor polynomial and a controlled remainder

examples.en: We applied Taylor's theorem to justify replacing the function by its cubic polynomial over a small interval.
examples.zh: 我们用「泰勒定理」说明在一个小区间上可用三次多项式近似函数。

examples.en: The tutor checked the differentiability assumptions of Taylor's theorem before stating the error bound in the example.
examples.zh: 导师先核查「泰勒定理」的可导性假设，再给出示例的误差界。

collocations: apply Taylor's theorem with a remainder
verify the hypotheses of Taylor's theorem

words.enDefinition: the power series whose coefficients are determined by successive derivatives at the centre divided by the corresponding factorials

examples.en: We calculated successive derivatives at the centre before writing the first four nonzero terms of the Taylor series.
examples.zh: 我们先在中心处计算各阶导数，再写出「泰勒级数」的前四个非零项。

examples.en: The tutor explained why a convergent Taylor series might differ from the function away from its centre.
examples.zh: 导师解释为什么「泰勒级数」可以收敛，却未必在离开中心的地方等于原函数。

collocations: study convergence of a Taylor series
represent a function by its Taylor series

words.enDefinition: a series whose partial sums simplify because consecutive contributions cancel

examples.en: The telescoping series left only the initial term and one final term after the cancellations in the exercise.
examples.zh: 在练习里，各项相消后，「裂项相消级数」的部分和只剩首项和末尾一项。

examples.en: We rewrote each fraction as a difference to show that the example was a telescoping series.
examples.zh: 我们将各分式改写成差，表明这是一个「裂项相消级数」。

collocations: write a telescoping series as differences

words.enDefinition: differentiating the individual terms of a series, which is valid for a power series inside its convergence radius

examples.en: We used term-by-term differentiation to obtain a power series for the derivative within the stated open interval.
examples.zh: 在所给开区间内，我们用「逐项求导」得到导函数的幂级数。

examples.en: The radius stayed the same after term-by-term differentiation, although the worksheet asked us to check the endpoints again.
examples.zh: 「逐项求导」后半径仍相同，但练习表要求我们重新核查两个端点。

collocations: find a derivative using term-by-term differentiation

words.enDefinition: integrating individual terms of a series, with convergence to the corresponding antiderivative inside a power series's convergence radius

examples.en: We obtained a series for the integral using term-by-term integration inside the example's radius of convergence.
examples.zh: 在示例的收敛半径内，我们用「逐项积分」得到积分的级数表示。

examples.en: The tutor added a constant after term-by-term integration to match the function's value at its centre.
examples.zh: 导师在「逐项积分」后加上常数，使所得函数在中心处的值与要求相符。

collocations: find a power series using term-by-term integration

words.enDefinition: A numerical quantity computed from the sample and compared with a reference distribution for a hypothesis test.

examples.en: The test statistic in our mean comparison is large when the difference is large relative to uncertainty.
examples.zh: 在这次均值比较中，差异相对其不确定性越大，「检验统计量」也越大。

examples.en: We calculated the test statistic and then located it on the reference distribution in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们算出「检验统计量」，再确定它在参考分布中的位置。

words.enDefinition: Statement that no single limiting value is approached under the stated convention

examples.en: We concluded that the limit does not exist because the outputs kept oscillating near zero.
examples.zh: 我们得出「极限不存在」的结论，因为函数值在零附近不断振荡。

examples.en: Where the branches approach different heights, the limit does not exist even if the function value is defined.
examples.zh: 两条分支趋近不同高度时，即使函数值有定义，「极限不存在」。

collocations: show that the limit does not exist
conclude that the limit does not exist
explain why the limit does not exist

words.enDefinition: a QR factorization of a tall matrix using the same number of orthonormal columns as the original matrix has columns

examples.en: The thin QR factorization kept three orthonormal columns for the matrix with many rows and only three columns.
examples.zh: 这个矩阵有很多行但只有三列，「精简 QR 分解」只保留三列标准正交向量。

examples.en: We used a thin QR factorization without storing the extra columns of a full orthogonal factor.
examples.zh: 我们使用「精简 QR 分解」，省去了完整正交因子中多余的列。

collocations: compare thin QR factorization with full QR factorization

words.enDefinition: Three numbers locating a point along three mutually perpendicular axes with a common origin.

examples.en: The worksheet gives three-dimensional Cartesian coordinates for each of the four vertices of a tetrahedron.
examples.zh: 练习纸给出了四面体四个顶点各自的「空间直角坐标」。

examples.en: We converted three-dimensional Cartesian coordinates to cylindrical coordinates before checking the radius of the point.
examples.zh: 我们先将「空间直角坐标」换成柱坐标，再核对该点的径向距离。

words.enDefinition: The signed rate at which a space curve's osculating plane twists per unit arc length where that plane is defined.

examples.en: The torsion vanishes along the circle because its osculating plane does not rotate along the curve.
examples.zh: 圆的「挠率」为零，因为它的密切平面沿曲线不会转动。

examples.en: We compared the torsion of a flat circle with that of the helix in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们将平面圆的「挠率」与螺旋线的挠率作了比较。

words.enDefinition: The ordinary derivative of a function evaluated along a curve, accounting for every changing coordinate.

examples.en: The total derivative along a curve measures how temperature changes as the model particle moves.
examples.zh: 「沿曲线的全导数」衡量模型粒子移动时温度如何变化。

examples.en: We evaluated the total derivative along a curve at the moment the particle crosses the axis.
examples.zh: 我们求出模型粒子经过坐标轴时的「沿曲线的全导数」。

collocations: compute the total derivative along a curve
interpret the total derivative along a curve
evaluate a total derivative along a curve

words.enDefinition: The linear change obtained by summing each partial derivative times its corresponding input change.

examples.en: The total differential estimates how the height changes when both horizontal coordinates vary slightly.
examples.zh: 「全微分」估计两个水平坐标都略有变化时，高度会如何变化。

examples.en: We wrote the total differential as a sum of two terms using the calculated partial derivatives.
examples.zh: 我们利用算出的偏导数，把「全微分」写成两项之和。

words.enDefinition: a fitting method that minimises the squared size of corrections to both the coefficient matrix and the observations

examples.en: We used total least squares because the predictor values and the recorded responses both contained measurement errors.
examples.zh: 由于预测变量的取值与记录的响应值均有测量误差，我们采用「总体最小二乘法」。

examples.en: In the line fitting example, total least squares minimized the sum of squared perpendicular distances to the line.
examples.zh: 在线性拟合示例中，「总体最小二乘法」使各点到直线的垂直距离平方和最小。

collocations: fit a line using total least squares
formulate a total least squares problem
compute a total least squares solution

words.enDefinition: A curve or other set formed where a surface intersects a specified plane.

examples.en: The trace of a surface in a horizontal plane is an ellipse in the worksheet example.
examples.zh: 在练习示例中，用水平平面截得的「曲面的截线」是一条椭圆。

examples.en: We drew the trace of a surface at a fixed height to help sketch its shape.
examples.zh: 我们在固定高度画出一条「曲面的截线」，帮助勾勒曲面形状。

collocations: find a trace of a surface
sketch a trace of a surface

words.enDefinition: a rule approximating integration using straight lines between neighbouring sampled endpoints, forming trapezoidal contributions

examples.en: The trapezoidal rule joined neighbouring values with straight line segments before adding the resulting areas.
examples.zh: 「梯形求积公式」用直线段连接相邻取值，再加总所得到的面积。

examples.en: We applied the trapezoidal rule to a measured rate that was available only at five times.
examples.zh: 只有五个时刻能拿到实测速率，我们将「梯形求积公式」用于这些数据。

collocations: compare the trapezoidal rule with Simpson's rule
estimate an integral with the trapezoidal rule

words.enDefinition: A square matrix whose entries on one side of the main diagonal are all zero.

examples.en: The tutor used a triangular matrix to calculate the determinant from only its diagonal entries.
examples.zh: 老师用一个「三角矩阵」举例，只用它的对角元素计算行列式。

examples.en: We checked both sides of the diagonal before classifying the example as a triangular matrix.
examples.zh: 把例题矩阵归为「三角矩阵」前，我们先检查了对角线两侧。

collocations: calculate the determinant of a triangular matrix
solve equations with a triangular matrix

words.enDefinition: an integral whose integrand involves trigonometric functions

examples.en: The trigonometric integral became simpler after the tutor rewrote its product of sine and cosine powers.
examples.zh: 导师改写正弦幂与余弦幂的乘积后，「三角函数积分」变得更简单。

examples.en: We checked whether the trigonometric integral contained an odd power that could supply a substitution factor.
examples.zh: 我们核查这道「三角函数积分」里是否有一个奇次幂，可分出换元所需的因子。

collocations: rewrite a trigonometric integral using identities
choose a method for a trigonometric integral

words.enDefinition: a substitution expressing a variable in terms of a trigonometric function, often simplifying a square root

examples.en: We applied trigonometric substitution to remove the square root of a difference of squares in the integrand.
examples.zh: 我们用「三角换元法」消去被积函数里一个平方差的平方根。

examples.en: The tutor drew a triangle after trigonometric substitution to express the result using the original variable.
examples.zh: 导师在「三角换元法」之后画出一个三角形，用原变量表示结果。

collocations: choose an angle range for trigonometric substitution
check a result from trigonometric substitution

words.enDefinition: An integral of a function over a three-dimensional region with respect to volume.

examples.en: The triple integral adds the varying density over the volume of the entire solid.
examples.zh: 这个「三重积分」在整个立体的体积上累加变化的密度。

examples.en: We used a triple integral with a constant integrand of one to calculate the solid's volume.
examples.zh: 我们用被积函数恒为一的「三重积分」，算出这个立体的体积。

words.enDefinition: The solution of a homogeneous linear system in which every unknown is zero.

examples.en: We substituted zeros for every unknown to verify the trivial solution in the homogeneous example.
examples.zh: 我们将各未知量都替换成零，验证齐次例题中的「平凡解」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked whether the system had another solution in addition to the trivial solution.
examples.zh: 老师问，方程组除了「平凡解」之外还有没有别的解。

collocations: distinguish the trivial solution from other solutions

words.enDefinition: approximating a matrix by keeping only a selected number of its largest singular values and corresponding directions

examples.en: The truncated singular value decomposition kept just the three strongest directions to approximate the original classroom data matrix.
examples.zh: 「截断奇异值分解」只保留三个最强方向来近似原课堂数据矩阵。

examples.en: We increased the rank of the truncated singular value decomposition to see how much the approximation error fell.
examples.zh: 我们提高「截断奇异值分解」保留的秩，查看近似误差减小多少。

collocations: compute a truncated singular value decomposition
choose the rank for a truncated singular value decomposition

words.enDefinition: A procedure that compares all pairs of group means while controlling family-wise error under its model assumptions.

examples.en: Tukey's HSD test compares every pair of mean readings from the three fictional production methods.
examples.zh: 「图基 HSD 检验」对三种虚构生产方法的平均读数做所有两两比较。

examples.en: We used Tukey's HSD test to report which pairs differed in the simulated classroom example.
examples.zh: 我们用「图基 HSD 检验」报告模拟课堂示例中哪些组间配对存在差异。

collocations: Tukey's HSD test for pairwise comparisons

words.enDefinition: An equivalence procedure that tests both sides of a specified equivalence range and requires both tests to reject.
acceptedEnVariants: equivalence test by two one-sided tests

examples.en: The two one-sided tests procedure requires rejecting both null hypotheses before declaring equivalence within the prespecified limits.
examples.zh: 「双单侧检验法」必须拒绝两个原假设，才能判定差异落在预设的等效界值内。

examples.en: We used the two one-sided tests procedure to evaluate equivalence in the simulated calibration exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在模拟校准练习中用「双单侧检验法」检验等效性。

collocations: apply the two one-sided tests procedure
assumptions of the two one-sided tests procedure
use the two one-sided tests procedure

words.enDefinition: A method for disproving a multivariable limit by finding two approach paths with different limiting values.

examples.en: The two-path test rules out a limit because the two approach paths give different values.
examples.zh: 两条趋近路径给出不同的值，因此「双路径判别法」否定了极限的存在。

examples.en: We chose a line and a parabola for the two-path test in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 在课堂示例中，我们选择一条直线和一条抛物线来做「双路径判别法」。

collocations: choose paths for the two-path test

words.enDefinition: A large-sample test comparing two population proportions using independent samples and a standard normal reference.

examples.en: The two-proportion z-test compares the fraction of acceptable pieces from two fictional production lines in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上的「双比例 z 检验」比较两条虚构生产线的合格零件比例。

examples.en: We checked the independence of the two samples before carrying out the two-proportion z-test in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们确认两个样本独立后，再做「双比例 z 检验」。

words.enDefinition: Common value approached as inputs come toward a point from either side

examples.en: The two-sided limit exists because both branches approach the same height near zero.
examples.zh: 由于两条分支在零附近都趋近同一高度，「双侧极限」存在。

examples.en: The two-sided limit fails to exist where the two sides approach different heights.
examples.zh: 两侧趋近不同高度的地方，「双侧极限」不存在。

words.enDefinition: A test that can reject the null for sufficiently large departures in either direction.

examples.en: The two-sided test asks whether the mean differs from the reference value in either direction.
examples.zh: 「双侧检验」检验均值是否在任一方向上偏离参考值。

examples.en: We marked two tail regions to represent the rejection rule for the two-sided test.
examples.zh: 我们标出两侧尾部，表示「双侧检验」的拒绝规则。

words.enDefinition: The error of rejecting a true null hypothesis.

examples.en: A Type I error occurs when the test flags a difference although the fictional population means match.
examples.zh: 两个虚构总体均值实际相同，检验却判出差异时，就犯了「第一类错误」。

examples.en: We counted each Type I error across simulations where the null hypothesis was exactly true.
examples.zh: 我们统计原假设确实为真的各次模拟中出现的「第一类错误」。

collocations: probability of a Type I error
control the Type I error rate

words.enDefinition: The error of failing to reject the null hypothesis at a specified alternative that is true.

examples.en: A Type II error occurs when the test misses the difference built into the fictional data.
examples.zh: 检验没能检测出虚构数据中设定的差异时，就犯了「第二类错误」。

examples.en: We counted each Type II error in the classroom simulation using a fixed nonzero population difference.
examples.zh: 我们在固定非零总体差异的课堂模拟里，统计了每次「第二类错误」。

collocations: probability of a Type II error

words.enDefinition: An estimator whose expected value equals the parameter for the sampling process under consideration.

examples.en: The unbiased estimator gives the correct value on average across repeated samples in the classroom illustration.
examples.zh: 在课堂示例的反复抽样中，「无偏估计量」给出平均意义下的正确值。

examples.en: We showed that an unbiased estimator may still give a poor result in one particular sample.
examples.zh: 我们说明，即使是「无偏估计量」，在某个特定样本里也可能给出较差的结果。

words.enDefinition: Finding an extremum of an objective function without imposing separate equality or inequality constraints.

examples.en: The unconstrained optimization problem allows both coordinates to vary freely in the whole input plane.
examples.zh: 这个「无约束优化」问题允许两个坐标在整个输入平面内自由变动。

examples.en: We used unconstrained optimization to look for the lowest point on the smooth modelled surface.
examples.zh: 我们用「无约束优化」寻找光滑模型曲面的最低点。

words.enDefinition: Variables with finite second moments and covariance equal to zero

examples.en: The example shows uncorrelated random variables that still depend on each other in a nonlinear way.
examples.zh: 例子展示了以非线性方式相互依赖的「不相关随机变量」。

examples.en: We classified the pair as uncorrelated random variables after calculating their covariance exactly.
examples.zh: 准确计算这两个变量的协方差后，我们将它们归为「不相关随机变量」。

collocations: distinguish uncorrelated random variables from independent ones

words.enDefinition: A sampling problem in which part of the target population is missing or inadequately represented in the frame.

examples.en: The exercise illustrates undercoverage because the list excludes students living outside the university residences.
examples.zh: 练习的名单排除了不住校的学生，因此出现「覆盖不足」。

examples.en: We drew a diagram showing which households are affected by undercoverage in the sample frame.
examples.zh: 我们画示意图，标出哪些家庭受到抽样框「覆盖不足」的影响。

words.enDefinition: a partition whose subintervals all have the same width

examples.en: The uniform partition split the interval into five parts, each exactly one unit wide in our diagram.
examples.zh: 示意图里的「等距分割」把区间分成五段，宽度各为一个单位。

examples.en: We used a uniform partition so the same rectangle width could be factored out of the sum.
examples.zh: 我们采用「等距分割」，这样可以把相同的矩形宽度从求和式中提出。

collocations: compute widths in a uniform partition

words.enDefinition: Upper bound on a union's probability given by summing the individual probabilities

examples.en: We used the union bound to bound the chance that at least one event occurred.
examples.zh: 我们用「并集概率上界」给至少发生一个事件的概率定出上界。

examples.en: The union bound stays valid even when some of the events can happen together.
examples.zh: 即使部分事件可以同时发生，「并集概率上界」仍然成立。

collocations: estimate a probability using the union bound

words.enDefinition: The only solution satisfying all the equations in a system.

examples.en: The example had a unique solution because no variable remained free after the elimination.
examples.zh: 消元后没有自由变量，例题因此有「唯一解」。

examples.en: We verified the unique solution by finding a pivot in every variable column of the consistent system.
examples.zh: 我们在相容方程组中每个变量列都找到了主元，据此验证存在「唯一解」。

collocations: check whether there is a unique solution

words.enDefinition: The length-one vector obtained by normalizing the nonzero velocity of a parametrized curve.

examples.en: The unit tangent vector shows the direction of motion at the marked point on the path.
examples.zh: 「单位切向量」显示沿路径运动到标记点时的方向。

examples.en: We computed a unit tangent vector by scaling the derivative to have length one.
examples.zh: 我们把导数向量缩放到长度为一，求出「单位切向量」。

collocations: unit tangent vector to a curve

words.enDefinition: A vector whose Euclidean length is one.

examples.en: We obtained a unit vector by dividing the nonzero vector by its length in the exercise.
examples.zh: 在练习中，我们把非零向量除以它的长度，得到一个「单位向量」。

examples.en: The unit vector points in the chosen direction without changing the scale of the directional derivative.
examples.zh: 「单位向量」指出选定方向，使方向导数按单位距离计量。

collocations: unit vector in a given direction

words.enDefinition: representing a complex matrix as a diagonal matrix under a unitary change of basis

examples.en: We used unitary diagonalization after finding a complex orthonormal basis of eigenvectors in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 在练习表上找到一组标准正交的复特征向量基后，我们用「酉对角化」。

examples.en: The proposed unitary diagonalization failed because two columns in its change-of-basis matrix had a nonzero inner product.
examples.zh: 所提的「酉对角化」方案不成立，因为其中的换基矩阵有两列的内积非零。

collocations: test whether a matrix admits unitary diagonalization

words.enDefinition: a complex square matrix whose conjugate transpose is its inverse

examples.en: The unitary matrix preserved the norms of the complex vectors used in the illustrative calculation.
examples.zh: 在示意计算中，「酉矩阵」保持所用复向量的范数不变。

examples.en: We found the inverse of the unitary matrix by transposing it and conjugating its entries.
examples.zh: 我们把「酉矩阵」转置并将各项取共轭，求出它的逆。

collocations: change basis using a unitary matrix
compute the inverse of a unitary matrix

words.enDefinition: similarity between complex square matrices by conjugation with a unitary matrix

examples.en: We verified unitary similarity by checking that the change-of-basis matrix preserved complex inner products in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中，我们核查换基矩阵能否保持复内积，以验证「酉相似」。

examples.en: The tutor used unitary similarity to show that the two matrices had the same singular values.
examples.zh: 导师用「酉相似」说明，两个矩阵具有相同的奇异值。

words.enDefinition: Choice of elements in which rearranging the selected items changes nothing

examples.en: The tutor treated choosing two volunteers as an unordered selection because they shared one role.
examples.zh: 因为两名志愿者承担同样的角色，老师把选出这两人视为「无序选择」。

examples.en: We counted each unordered selection once even if the objects could be listed differently.
examples.zh: 即使物品可以按不同顺序列出，我们对每种「无序选择」也只计一次。

words.enDefinition: a sum using the supremum of a bounded function on each subinterval times the width of that subinterval

examples.en: The upper Darboux sum used the least upper bound of the function values on each subinterval.
examples.zh: 「达布上和」使用四个子区间上各自的函数上确界。

examples.en: We refined the partition to reduce the upper Darboux sum for the increasing function in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们细化分割，以降低练习中递增函数的「达布上和」。

collocations: bound the integral by an upper Darboux sum

words.enDefinition: the ending bound written above the integral sign in a definite integral

examples.en: The upper limit of integration changed with the position where the student stopped measuring the accumulated area.
examples.zh: 学生测量累计面积的终点改变时，「积分上限」也随之改变。

examples.en: We evaluated the antiderivative at the upper limit of integration before subtracting its value at the lower bound.
examples.zh: 我们先求原函数在「积分上限」处的值，再减掉它在下限处的值。

collocations: choose the upper limit of integration
evaluate at the upper limit of integration
vary the upper limit of integration

words.enDefinition: A square matrix with every entry below its main diagonal equal to zero.

examples.en: We obtained an upper triangular matrix after eliminating the entries below each pivot in the exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们消掉各主元下方的元素后得到了一个「上三角矩阵」。

examples.en: The last equation was easy to solve because the coefficients formed an upper triangular matrix.
examples.zh: 系数构成「上三角矩阵」，因此最后一个方程很容易解。

collocations: reduce to an upper triangular matrix
solve a system with an upper triangular matrix
the determinant of an upper triangular matrix

words.enDefinition: the variable with respect to which an integral is taken

examples.en: We identified the variable of integration before deciding which symbols represented fixed parameters in the expression.
examples.zh: 我们先识别「积分变量」，再判断表达式中哪些符号表示固定参数。

examples.en: The tutor changed the variable of integration to show that a definite integral's value remained the same.
examples.zh: 导师更换「积分变量」的名称，说明定积分的值没有变化。

collocations: change the variable of integration by substitution

words.enDefinition: Expected squared difference between a variable and its own mean

examples.en: We found the variance of a random variable by averaging squared deviations using their probabilities.
examples.zh: 我们以概率加权计算平方偏差的平均值，求出了「随机变量的方差」。

examples.en: The variance of a random variable is zero when its value never changes across outcomes.
examples.zh: 如果变量在所有结果中始终取同一个值，「随机变量的方差」就是零。

collocations: calculate the variance of a random variable
compare the variance of a random variable
formula for the variance of a random variable

words.enDefinition: Variance of combined variables, accounting for each variance and pairwise covariance

examples.en: For independent variables, we calculated the variance of a sum by adding their individual variances.
examples.zh: 对于独立变量，我们将各自的方差相加，得到「和的方差」。

examples.en: The variance of a sum included a positive covariance term for the two related measurements.
examples.zh: 这两个相关的测量值有正协方差，因此计算「和的方差」时包含一项正的协方差贡献。

collocations: calculate the variance of a sum
variance of a sum of independent variables
formula for the variance of a sum

words.enDefinition: An equation expressing each position vector on a line as a fixed position vector plus a scalar multiple of a direction vector.

examples.en: The vector equation of a line gives the starting point when the parameter is zero.
examples.zh: 「直线的向量方程」在参数为零时给出所选起始点。

examples.en: We wrote a vector equation of a line through the two points shown in the diagram.
examples.zh: 我们写出通过图中两点的「直线的向量方程」。

collocations: write a vector equation of a line
use the vector equation of a line
derive the vector equation of a line

words.enDefinition: A function assigning a vector to each point in a region.

examples.en: The vector field uses arrows to show the fluid velocity at several marked points.
examples.zh: 「向量场」用箭头显示几个标记点处的流体速度。

examples.en: We sketched the vector field before deciding whether any arrows point inward along the circle.
examples.zh: 我们先勾画「向量场」，再查看圆周上有没有箭头指向圆内。

words.enDefinition: The integral along an oriented curve of a vector field's tangential component with respect to arc length.
acceptedEnVariants: line integral of a vector field

examples.en: The vector line integral measures how much the force contributes along the chosen direction of travel.
examples.zh: 「第二类曲线积分」衡量力沿选定运动方向累积的作用。

examples.en: We reversed the curve orientation and saw the vector line integral change its sign.
examples.zh: 我们将曲线取向反转，看到「第二类曲线积分」改变了符号。

collocations: vector line integral along a path

words.enDefinition: The nonnegative length of a vector in Euclidean geometry.

examples.en: The vector magnitude is five when the two perpendicular component vectors have lengths three and four.
examples.zh: 两个互相垂直的分量长度分别是三和四时，「向量的模」是五。

examples.en: We checked the vector magnitude before rescaling the arrow in the geometry exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在几何练习中缩放箭头之前，先核对了「向量的模」。

words.enDefinition: A set with addition and scalar multiplication satisfying the vector space axioms over a field.

examples.en: The class used polynomials to build a vector space in which the vectors were functions.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们用多项式构造了一个「向量空间」，其中的向量是函数。

examples.en: Our new vector space came with rules for adding elements and multiplying them by scalars.
examples.zh: 这个新「向量空间」规定了如何将元素相加以及如何给元素乘以标量。

collocations: the zero vector of a vector space
a basis for a vector space

words.enDefinition: One of the rules a space's vector addition and scalar multiplication must satisfy.

examples.en: Our tutor pointed out the vector space axiom that guarantees an additive inverse for each vector.
examples.zh: 辅导老师指出了保证每个向量都有加法逆元的那条「向量空间公理」。

examples.en: The group checked a vector space axiom by showing that changing parentheses did not affect addition.
examples.zh: 小组通过证明改变括号位置不影响加法，验证了一条「向量空间公理」。

words.enDefinition: A function whose output at each input is a vector.

examples.en: The vector-valued function gives the position of the moving point at each recorded time.
examples.zh: 「向量值函数」给出运动点在各记录时刻的位置。

examples.en: We graphed the path traced by the vector-valued function as its parameter increased from zero.
examples.zh: 我们画出参数从零开始增加时，「向量值函数」描出的路径。

words.enDefinition: Vertical line approached along a branch whose values diverge to infinity

examples.en: The function has a vertical asymptote where the left branch falls without bound.
examples.zh: 函数左侧分支无界下降的地方有一条「竖直渐近线」。

examples.en: We checked the limit before deciding that the denominator's zero gave a vertical asymptote.
examples.zh: 断定分母为零处存在「竖直渐近线」之前，我们先检查了极限。

words.enDefinition: Tangent line parallel to the vertical axis, with unbounded nearby secant slopes

examples.en: The curve passes through the origin and has a vertical tangent there.
examples.zh: 曲线穿过原点，并在原点有一条「竖直切线」。

examples.en: We distinguished the vertical tangent from an asymptote by checking the point on the curve.
examples.zh: 我们检查了曲线上的那个点，从而区分「竖直切线」和渐近线。

words.enDefinition: A plane region lying between two functions of the horizontal coordinate over one horizontal interval.

examples.en: The vertically simple region has a lower curve and an upper curve over the same horizontal interval.
examples.zh: 「竖直方向简单区域」在同一水平区间内有一条下边界曲线和一条上边界曲线。

examples.en: We integrated with respect to the vertical coordinate first because the example uses a vertically simple region.
examples.zh: 示例属于「竖直方向简单区域」，所以我们先对竖直坐标积分。

collocations: integrate over a vertically simple region
bounds of a vertically simple region

words.enDefinition: A systematic error caused by people choosing to respond in ways related to the topic or outcome.

examples.en: The class discussed voluntary response bias because students with strong opinions were more likely to participate.
examples.zh: 全班讨论了「自愿应答偏差」，因为意见强烈的学生更可能参与。

examples.en: We examined whether voluntary response bias could distort satisfaction results from the open online survey.
examples.zh: 我们考察「自愿应答偏差」会不会让开放式网络调查的满意度结果失真。

words.enDefinition: A confidence interval formed from an estimate plus or minus a reference quantile times its estimated standard error.

examples.en: The Wald interval in this example uses the observed sample proportion in its standard error.
examples.zh: 该示例中的「沃尔德区间」在计算标准误时使用观测样本比例。

examples.en: We examined a Wald interval whose lower endpoint falls below zero in the proportion exercise.
examples.zh: 我们在比例练习中考察了一个下端点低于零的「沃尔德区间」。

words.enDefinition: finding volume by integrating the areas of annular cross sections with outer and inner radii

examples.en: The washer method subtracted each inner disk's area from its outer disk's area before integrating.
examples.zh: 「垫片法」先用各外圆盘面积减去内圆盘面积，再积分。

examples.en: We chose the washer method because rotating the region left a hole around the vertical axis.
examples.zh: 我们选「垫片法」，因为旋转后的区域在竖轴周围留下了空洞。

collocations: identify the inner radius in the washer method
calculate volume using the washer method

words.enDefinition: Result that averages converge in probability to their common mean under conditions

examples.en: By the weak law of large numbers, the chance of exceeding any fixed error threshold tends to zero.
examples.zh: 「弱大数定律」说明，随着试验次数增多，偏差超过给定阈值的概率会趋近零。

examples.en: We proved the weak law of large numbers for independent identically distributed observations with finite variance.
examples.zh: 我们对具有有限方差的独立同分布观测值证明了「弱大数定律」。

collocations: apply the weak law of large numbers
prove the weak law of large numbers
example of the weak law of large numbers

words.enDefinition: an inner product constructed to give different weight to directions, for example by using a positive definite weight matrix

examples.en: The weighted inner product made the first coordinate contribute twice as much in the worksheet's alignment calculation.
examples.zh: 练习计算向量对齐程度时，「加权内积」使第一坐标的贡献变为两倍。

examples.en: We used a weighted inner product to compare the two signals after accounting for unequal measurement scales.
examples.zh: 考虑到测量尺度不同时，我们用「加权内积」比较两个信号。

collocations: derive a norm from a weighted inner product

words.enDefinition: a norm that assigns stated weights to components through a specified positive definite metric or inner product

examples.en: The exercise used a weighted norm to make differences in one coordinate count more than in another.
examples.zh: 练习使用「加权范数」，使某个坐标的差异在度量中的比重高于另一个。

examples.en: We compared the two residuals using a weighted norm because their observed coordinates had different scales.
examples.zh: 由于它们各观测坐标的尺度不同，我们用「加权范数」比较两个残差。

words.enDefinition: An analysis-of-variance procedure for comparing group means without assuming equal population variances.

examples.en: Welch's ANOVA compares mean readings across three independently sampled groups with different spreads in this exercise.
examples.zh: 练习中的「韦尔奇方差分析」比较三个独立抽取、离散程度各异的组的平均读数。

examples.en: We discussed which reference degrees of freedom Welch's ANOVA uses for the simulated classroom data.
examples.zh: 我们讨论「韦尔奇方差分析」为课堂模拟数据采用哪个参考自由度。

words.enDefinition: A t-based test of two independent means that estimates the groups' variances separately and adjusts the reference degrees of freedom.

examples.en: Welch's t-test allows the two groups in the exercise to have different population variances.
examples.zh: 「韦尔奇 t 检验」允许练习中的两组具有不同的总体方差。

examples.en: We used Welch's t-test to compare means for the two independently sampled sets of readings.
examples.zh: 我们用「韦尔奇 t 检验」比较独立抽出的两组读数的均值。

collocations: degrees of freedom for Welch's t-test

words.zhGloss: 韦尔奇—萨特思韦特自由度
words.enDefinition: An approximate reference degrees-of-freedom value calculated from sample sizes and variance estimates for an unequal-variance comparison.
acceptedZhAnswers: 韦尔奇—萨特思韦特自由度

examples.en: The Welch-Satterthwaite degrees of freedom need not be a whole number in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 课堂示例里的「韦尔奇—萨特思韦特自由度」可以不是整数。

examples.en: We computed the Welch-Satterthwaite degrees of freedom before looking up the approximate reference value.
examples.zh: 我们先算出「韦尔奇—萨特思韦特自由度」，再查近似参考值。

words.enDefinition: a matrix with a modest condition number for the specified problem, so small input changes need not cause large relative changes

examples.en: The well-conditioned matrix gave nearly the same solution after we slightly perturbed the measured right-hand side in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上，我们轻微扰动测得的方程组右侧向量，「良态矩阵」对应的解仍几乎相同。

examples.en: We compared a well-conditioned matrix with one whose largest singular value was much greater than its smallest.
examples.zh: 我们把「良态矩阵」与另一个最大奇异值远大于最小奇异值的矩阵比较。

collocations: compare a well-conditioned matrix with an ill-conditioned one

words.zhGloss: 威尔科克森符号秩检验
words.enDefinition: A test of the centre of a symmetric difference distribution using ranks of absolute differences together with their signs.
acceptedZhAnswers: 威尔科克森符号秩检验

examples.en: The Wilcoxon signed-rank test ranks the absolute paired differences before attaching their original signs in class.
examples.zh: 课堂上的「威尔科克森符号秩检验」先对配对差值的绝对值排序，再加回各自原有的正负号。

examples.en: We discussed symmetry of the differences before interpreting the Wilcoxon signed-rank test in the exercise.
examples.zh: 解读练习中的「威尔科克森符号秩检验」前，我们先讨论差值分布的对称性。

collocations: assumptions of a Wilcoxon signed-rank test

words.enDefinition: A binomial proportion interval obtained by inverting the score test for candidate probabilities.

examples.en: The Wilson score interval stays within the possible range of proportions in the small sample exercise.
examples.zh: 在小样本练习中，「威尔逊得分区间」落在比例的可能取值范围内。

examples.en: We compared the Wilson score interval with the simple normal approximation in the classroom example.
examples.zh: 我们将课堂示例的「威尔逊得分区间」与简单正态近似作了比较。

collocations: Wilson score interval for a proportion

words.enDefinition: The sum of squared deviations of each observation from its own group's mean.

examples.en: The within-group sum of squares measures spread around separate group averages in the classroom data.
examples.zh: 「组内平方和」衡量课堂数据围绕各自组均值的离散程度。

examples.en: We found the within-group sum of squares before dividing by the corresponding degrees of freedom.
examples.zh: 我们先算出「组内平方和」，再除以相应自由度。

collocations: calculate the within-group sum of squares
report the within-group sum of squares

words.enDefinition: an integral of the force component along the direction of displacement over the distance moved

examples.en: The work integral added the contributions of a force that changed as the spring stretched farther.
examples.zh: 「功的积分」累加了弹簧越拉越长时不断变化的力所作的各份功。

examples.en: We set up the work integral using the displacement bounds shown in the classroom sketch.
examples.zh: 我们利用课堂草图标示的位移范围列出「功的积分」。

collocations: use a work integral for a variable force

words.enDefinition: Signed number of standard deviations separating a value from its mean

examples.en: The z-score was negative because the recorded wait was below its mean.
examples.zh: 由于记录下的等待时间比均值短，「标准分数」为负。

examples.en: We calculated a z-score to compare the two measurements on a common scale.
examples.zh: 我们计算「标准分数」，用同一尺度比较这两个测量值。

collocations: convert a value to a z-score

words.enDefinition: an eigenvalue for which the associated nonzero eigenvectors are mapped to zero

examples.en: The zero eigenvalue identified an input direction that the matrix collapsed to the zero vector.
examples.zh: 「零特征值」指出一个输入方向，在该方向上的向量被矩阵映射为零向量。

examples.en: The square matrix had a zero eigenvalue because its null space contained a nonzero vector.
examples.zh: 这个方阵的零空间含有非零向量，所以它有一个「零特征值」。

collocations: find the eigenspace for a zero eigenvalue
identify a matrix with a zero eigenvalue

words.enDefinition: A matrix with every entry equal to zero.

examples.en: Subtracting the table of values from itself gave us a zero matrix in the example.
examples.zh: 例题里，用这张数值表减去它自身，得到了一个「零矩阵」。

examples.en: Our tutor asked for a zero matrix with the same dimensions as the original.
examples.zh: 老师要求写出一个与原矩阵行列数相同的「零矩阵」。

words.enDefinition: Quotient limit pattern in which numerator and denominator both approach zero

examples.en: The zero over zero form disappeared after we canceled a common factor outside the excluded point.
examples.zh: 我们在排除点之外约去公因式后，「零比零未定式」消失了。

examples.en: We recognized a zero over zero form because both expressions vanished at the approach point.
examples.zh: 因为两个式子在趋近的点都为零，我们判断这是「零比零未定式」。

collocations: identify a zero over zero form
reduce to a zero over zero form
resolve a zero over zero form

words.enDefinition: Event assigned probability zero even if it contains possible outcomes

examples.en: In the continuous model, obtaining exactly five is a zero-probability event with one possible value.
examples.zh: 在该连续模型中，恰好取五是一个含有一种可能取值的「零概率事件」。

examples.en: An interval of positive length had positive probability, while its endpoint formed a zero-probability event.
examples.zh: 一个有正长度的区间在该例中概率为正，其中一个端点对应「零概率事件」。

words.enDefinition: The subspace containing only the zero vector.

examples.en: A basis for the zero subspace contains no vectors, so its dimension is zero.
examples.zh: 「零子空间」的基不含任何向量，因此其维数为零。

examples.en: The two spaces in our example intersected in the zero subspace, as predicted by the calculation.
examples.zh: 正如计算所示，例题中的两个空间相交于「零子空间」。
